Title: Senior Technical Delivery Manager - Web & Cloud Platforms
Industry: Broadcast Media Production and Distribution, Book and Periodical Publishing, and Telecommunications
Description:
Our Technology team wakes up every day with one goal in mind - connecting Canadians to the people and things that matter most. Together, we are proud to support 30 million Canadians each month through managing a robust portfolio that champions leading-edge technology. We drive large-scale, complex, and high-visibility technology projects and programs that shape the future of technology in Canada and expand connectivity from coast to coast. If you are interested in being a part of this, consider applying for the following opportunity
  
  
**Who We're Looking For**
As Senior Technical Delivery Manager, you will build and lead high-performance engineering teams that deliver and run our Web, Services, Middleware and Cloud Native platforms. You will own the full lifecycle, from strategy and architecture through delivery and day-to-day operations, using modern technologies such as React, Angular, Node.js, Java/Spring Boot and .NET, deployed on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud with Kubernetes and serverless services.
  
  
This is a leadership role with two equal mandates drive innovation at the core of how we build, and achieve operational excellence in how we run. You will set engineering direction, grow managers and senior engineers, and deliver industry-standard, secure and scalable solutions that let our customers self-serve. You will partner with senior leadership to align technology investment with business outcomes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build, lead and grow high-performance delivery teams, including managers and technical leads.
* Own the strategy and roadmap for Web, Services, Middleware and Cloud Native platforms.
* Drive innovation by evaluating emerging technologies and scaling proven ideas into production. Deliver large programs end to end, on time, on budget and against clear KPIs.
* Oversee architecture, integration and code quality to industry standards, including APIs, microservices and GraphQL.
* Lead cloud-native build and migration, with strong DevOps, automation and cost control.
* Embed secure authentication and SSO across applications, working with security and identity teams.
* Own operational excellence availability, SLOs, incident management, monitoring and root cause analysis.
* Partner with Product, Design, Data, Security and Operations, and present strategy and trade-offs to senior leadership.

**What You Need To Succeed**

* Cloud experience (required) hands-on depth with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP), including PaaS, containers and Kubernetes, serverless and cloud-native architecture patterns.
* Proven record of building and leading high-performance engineering teams, including managing managers, in an enterprise environment.
* Strong expertise across web application frameworks (React, Angular or Vue on the frontend; Node.js, Java/Spring Boot on the backend), backend services and APIs, microservices and middleware.
* Solid knowledge of integration and middleware technologies API gateways, messaging and event streaming, ESB and iPaaS.
* Deep understanding of industry standards for connecting domain services, microservices and experience-layer services such as GraphQL and REST.
* Mature DevOps and SRE practice CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, SLOs and incident management.
* Strong leadership in Agile delivery at scale, with a track record of shipping quickly without compromising quality or stability.
* Data-driven, KPI-focused approach, using tools such as 5-why analysis, A/B testing and performance benchmarking.
* Ability to balance innovation with operational stability, cost and risk.
* Excellent communication, with the ability to influence senior leaders and translate complex engineering topics into business value.
* Curiosity, creativity and a bias for action when tackling complex problems.

**Nice to have**

* Knowledge of authentication and identity platforms, such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Identity, ForgeRock or Auth0.
* Experience implementing SSO and identity federation using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and SAML.
* Familiarity with customer identity (CIAM), MFA and zero-trust security models.
* Relevant certifications, such as a cloud architect certification, Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD) or SAFe.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field.
* 10+ years of experience in software engineering and technical delivery, including 5+ years leading engineering teams and 3+ years managing managers or multiple squads.
* Proven delivery of web, services, middleware and cloud-native solutions at enterprise scale.
* A track record of running production platforms with measurable gains in reliability, performance and cost.
* A passion for digital transformation and a demonstrated ability to deliver innovative solutions that improve customer experience.

**What’s in it for you?**
We believe in investing in our people and helping them reach their potential as valuable members of our team. As part of our team, you’ll have access to a wide range of incredible resources, growth opportunities, discounts, and perks, including

Title: Data Center Program Manager
Description:
**Overview**

As a Microsoft **Data Center Project Manager** (DCPM), you will perform troubleshooting for service incidents, manage assigned projects to meet service delivery objectives as well escalate to appropriate stakeholders to remove obstacles. You will also follow safety policies and procedures and participate in root cause analysis (RCA) of incidents. This job will allow you to build a solid understanding of data center procedures, engage in collaboration across various teams as well as provide mentorship across data centers by sharing best practices.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCPM, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 data centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Demonstrate conscientiousness on cost adheres to budget requirements; keep costs reasonable and contribute to staying within budget.
* Follow and adhere to safety and security policies and procedures. Report immediately any safety or security issues or concerns.

* Perform troubleshooting for service incidents and escalates, as appropriate, to meet SLA/OLAs, with minimal disruption to the client/customer and business.
* Recognize potential customer impact of other events and issues (e.g., customer lockdown), communicate potential impact, and plan for impact accordingly.
* Proactively review schedules and avoid conflicts when possible. Identify, coordinate, manage expectations, and offer alternatives when defining customer solutions.
* Manage relationships with clients and suppliers to ensure that all expectations are clarified, understood, documented, and met.
* Suggest ways for reducing the risk of performing maintenance; work with others to accommodate scheduling needs.
* In alignment with management priorities, hold self-accountable for the end-to-end service quality, completeness, and resulting customer experience (including but not limited to availability, safety, security, customer service). Support escalation of issues to appropriate owner.
* Embody our culture and values.

**Required Qualifications:**

* High School Qualification or equivalent AND 2+ years experience supporting IT equipment or related technology or delivering server and network deployment projects in large-scale environments
  + OR equivalent experience

* **Microsoft Cloud Background Check:** This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 2+ years’ experience in Critical Environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU) or working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling).
* Technical College degree in Computer Science, Math, Telecommunications, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or related field.

Title: Senior Telemetry Service Operations Manager
Description:
**Overview**
As a Microsoft
**Senior Telemetry Service Operations Manager**
, you will own the availability, quality, and trustworthiness of critical environment (CE) telemetry across Microsoft’s global data center fleet. You will set operational standards and drive external providers and internal engineering teams to resolve complex issues, improve service performance, and reduce systemic risk.
  
  
Telemetry Service Operations (TSO) monitors telemetry availability and quality across Microsoft’s data center portfolio. The team takes a proactive approach by identifying availability, quality, and operational issues before they affect the teams that depend on the data. We validate issues before escalation, so partners receive actionable information.
  
  
Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As part of CO+I, you will play a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft’s online services, including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. CO+I supports the personal and professional development of employees through training, growth opportunities, career rotation programs, inclusion programs, and professional certifications.
  
  
Our infrastructure comprises a global portfolio of more than 300 data centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. It is built and managed by subject matter experts who support services used by more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries.
  
  
With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve to meet changing business demands.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to achieve our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own telemetry health for a region or external-provider portfolio; independently detect and validate complex incidents; determine severity, scope, and business impact in ambiguous situations; and identify fleet-level or systemic risks.
* Own complex and long-running incidents through their full lifecycle, set the standard for investigation and record quality, manage provider escalation paths, and drive accountability for remediation and service-level performance.
* Lead post-incident review and problem management for major, recurring, or high-impact issues; confirm root causes, assess wider fleet exposure, and drive corrective actions to closure across organizational boundaries.
* Set direction for closing telemetry-coverage and detection gaps, translate operational risk into prioritized engineering requirements, and lead automation and alert-tuning initiatives that improve detection coverage and reduce manual effort.
* Own service-acceptance standards, operating procedures, playbooks, and knowledge content for an assigned area, and resolve cross-team issues when telemetry does not meet readiness criteria.
* Define service measures and reporting, represent telemetry performance and external-provider accountability in operational reviews, and communicate risks and remediation status to leadership and partner organizations.
* Lead cross-team service-quality initiatives and mentor service managers and vendor staff, acting as an escalation point for difficult incidents, investigations, and external-provider engagements.
* Participate in a shared on-call rotation supporting 24x7x365 telemetry operations, including scheduled coverage outside standard business hours, weekends, and holidays, and serve as the senior escalation point for major incidents during those periods.
* Set a continuous feedback loop with downstream customers and act as the coordinator between users of the data and telemetry technical implementation groups.
* Embody our culture and values.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field AND 4+ years of technical experience in service operations, service engineering, systems engineering, critical environment operations, industrial control systems, or incident management

+ OR equivalent experience.

**Other Requirements**
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
  
  

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications**
While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Domain background in data center critical environments, electrical, industrial, or mechanical systems, gained through formal study or hands-on field experience.
* 5+ years of experience in an operational, mission-critical, 24x7x365 environment.
* 3+ years of experience leading incident, problem, or service-management work, including formal root-cause analysis, post-incident review, and corrective-action ownership; ITIL or equivalent service-management experience.
* Deep working knowledge of data center critical environment equipment, industrial control systems, and telemetry data flows, including generators, uninterruptible power supplies, power distribution units, switchgear, Modbus, or BACnet.
* Experience analyzing large operational datasets and defining service measures or dashboards using tools such as Kusto, SQL, Power BI, or Grafana.
* Experience holding third-party providers accountable through escalations and performance reviews and driving corrective action across teams without direct authority.
* Experience defining operational standards, playbooks, or service processes and mentoring less-experienced engineers or service managers.
* Deep working knowledge of data center critical environment equipment, industrial control systems, and telemetry data flows, including generators, uninterruptible power supplies, power distribution units, switchgear, Modbus, or BACnet.
* Experience using Kusto Query Language (KQL) or similar tools to query and analyze large-scale telemetry or operational data.

Nous croyons à l’autonomisation de chacun. C’est pourquoi nous dotons nos équipes d’une technologie de pointe, d’outils d’IA et d’un environnement collaboratif qui soutient la créativité et la croissance. Voulez-vous faire partie d’une équipe diversifiée où votre travail a un réel impact? Si vous êtes inspiré par l’innovation qui fait progresser la façon dont les gens se connectent et transforme ce qui est possible, vous avez votre place au sein de l’#ÉquipeBell.
  
  
Faites partie de notre équipe Expérience client, où vous aurez un rôle déterminant dans l’élaboration des expériences client. Vous vous appuierez sur l’impératif stratégique de Bell qui s’intitule « Promouvoir l’expérience client » et renforcerez notre engagement à donner la priorité au client dans tout ce que nous faisons. Vous concevrez des processus, des politiques, des produits et des services novateurs axés sur le client, tout en respectant nos engagements envers le client afin qu'il soit plus facile pour eux de faire affaire avec Bell.
  
  
En tant que membre de notre équipe, vous serez au cœur de l’expérience client.
  
  
**Résumé**
Chaque projet d'envergure au sein du Réseau d’IA tissé de Bell soulève des centaines de questions :
  
  
L'alimentation électrique est-elle suffisante? La connectivité peut-elle être livrée? Quels sont les enjeux réglementaires, environnementaux, commerciaux, communautaires, opérationnels ou techniques? Quels risques demeurent inconnus? Bell devrait-elle aller de l'avant, adapter son approche, suspendre ou abandonner l'occasion?
  
  
Ce poste existe pour répondre à ces questions. Vous recueillerez et validerez les faits, structurerez les analyses, coordonnerez les activités de diligence interfonctionnelles, intégrerez les résultats et présenterez des recommandations claires. Vous deviendrez une référence de confiance quant aux faits, aux risques, aux dépendances, aux décisions et aux prochaines étapes des dossiers qui vous seront confiés.
  
  
**Principales responsabilités**
Diriger les activités d'évaluation et de diligence raisonnable
  
  

* Diriger les évaluations et analyses de diligence pour les opportunités assignées, de l'évaluation préliminaire jusqu'à la recommandation finale et à la préparation de l'exécution.
* Coordonner les analyses techniques, commerciales, financières, opérationnelles, réglementaires, environnementales et communautaires.
* Structurer des enjeux complexes en hypothèses, analyses, plans de travail et cadres décisionnels clairs.
* Cerner les lacunes d'information, les questions non résolues et les hypothèses critiques, puis établir les plans nécessaires pour obtenir et valider les données requises.

Soutenir la prise de décision des dirigeants
  
  

* Transformer de grands volumes d'information en recommandations claires et exploitables pour les dirigeants.
* Présenter de façon concise les options, les compromis, les risques, les dépendances et les recommandations.
* Soutenir les discussions avec les dirigeants, les clients, les partenaires, les gouvernements et d'autres intervenants clés grâce à des analyses fondées sur les faits.
* Veiller à ce que les décisions soient prises à partir d'une information exacte, complète et fiable.

Agir comme référence pour les dossiers sous votre responsabilité
  
  

* Maintenir une vue consolidée et à jour des faits, hypothèses, risques, décisions et dépendances.
* Assurer la traçabilité des décisions et de leur justification.
* Produire et maintenir une documentation claire et structurée.
* Fournir une visibilité continue sur l'avancement des dossiers et les décisions à venir.

Assurer la coordination interfonctionnelle et la préparation à l'exécution
  
  

* Traduire les opportunités en plans de réalisation intégrés comportant des responsabilités, échéanciers, livrables et jalons clairement définis.
* Coordonner les activités entre les équipes internes, les consultants, les fournisseurs de services publics, les partenaires d'ingénierie et les parties externes.
* Gérer les mandats confiés à des experts et conseillers externes.
* Assurer le suivi des engagements, des dépendances et des échéanciers.
* Faire remonter rapidement les enjeux, risques ou décisions nécessitant l'attention de la direction.

Renforcer la gouvernance et les façons de faire
  
  

* Développer et améliorer un modèle de gouvernance par étapes permettant d'évaluer les opportunités selon des critères cohérents.
* Contribuer à la priorisation des initiatives et à l'allocation des ressources.
* Mettre en place des cadres, méthodologies et outils réutilisables afin d'augmenter l'efficacité du Réseau d’IA tissé de Bell à mesure de sa croissance.

Réaliser des analyses stratégiques
  
  

* Mener des recherches, analyses comparatives, entrevues avec des intervenants et analyses de données.
* Remettre en question les hypothèses et distinguer les faits des estimations.
* Détecter les enjeux émergents susceptibles d'influencer les décisions stratégiques.
* Mettre à profit les outils d'IA et d'analyse pour accélérer le travail tout en maintenant un haut niveau de rigueur et d'esprit critique.

* Forte capacité à évoluer dans des contextes caractérisés par l'ambiguïté et l'information incomplète.

Title: Network Development Manager, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) Networking
Description:
**Description**
Application deadline: Nov 15, 2026
  
  
Amazon's network is a key differentiator for AWS, enabling the global operation of thousands of applications across hundreds of thousands of servers worldwide. Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) extends that platform to the U.S. Government's most sensitive workloads, delivering AWS inside air-gapped, classified regions where the bar for reliability, security, and operational rigor is at its highest.
  
  
We are looking for a Network Development Manager to hire, manage, and develop a team of Network Development Engineers responsible for the end-to-end operational health of the ADC network. You will own capacity management and forecast planning, implementation, automation, change control, process management, and continuous improvement across the classified partitions. You will represent networking to service teams, infrastructure partners, and government stakeholders, ensuring we meet their needs for innovation, delivery, and safe operations in an environment where the margin for error is small and much of the tooling and telemetry commercial teams rely on has to be built.
  
  
At Amazon, we ask our technical leaders to be strong engineers who dive deep and help their engineers make sound decisions and deliver quality solutions. You will maintain a solid technical understanding of routing, switching, optical transport, and network automation, and ensure the right expertise exists on the team. You will also be a thoughtful people manager who mentors your engineers and builds an environment of mutual trust and respect, which matters even more in ADC where teams are smaller, more isolated, and carry a heavier operational load per person. The ideal candidate has a track record of driving operations and continuous improvement for large-scale, mission-critical networks, a passion for operational excellence, and the judgment to safely implement change, measure performance, and respond to events so the network always operates as intended.
  
  
The candidate selected must obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the end-to-end operational health of the ADC network across the classified partitions: availability, performance, change control, and continuous improvement.
* Hire, develop, and retain a team of Network Development Engineers; own onboarding, career growth, 1:1s, and mentoring.
* Run a sustainable on-call rotation that honors SLAs without burning out a small classified-region team.
* Ensure network changes are designed, reviewed, and executed safely at scale under ADC's access and change-control constraints.
* Drive incidents and availability risks to resolution, and own Correction of Error (COE) follow-through so problems do not recur.
* Manage operations with data, metrics, and dashboards; build the monitoring, automation, and tooling ADC has historically lacked.
* Define and deliver team goals, align resources, and report status and risk to leadership.
* Close parity gaps with commercial AWS and contribute an ADC lens to standard planning (OP1/OP2).
* Represent networking to service, infrastructure, and government stakeholders so dependencies and deliverables are met.

A day in the life
  
  
You lead a team of Network Development Engineers operating AWS's network inside classified regions. A typical day mixes 1:1s and career coaching with reviewing network changes, walking through an incident or COE with an engineer, and unblocking cross-team dependencies. You spend time on the metrics that show where the network and the team need attention, and on the tooling, automation, and monitoring ADC is still building. You balance day-to-day operations against longer-term parity and capacity goals, and you represent networking to service, infrastructure, and government partners. You also participate in a management on-call escalation rotation.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
* 4+ years of managing teams experience
* 5+ years of engineering experience
* 8+ years of technology role experience
* Experience with network operations either as a manager or individual contributor

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience contributing to the creation and implementation of high-quality, high-volume recruiting plans
* Experience contributing to the definition and implementation of automation opportunities within an operations environment
* Experience representing your team or technical area to senior management

**Data Center Site Portfolio Management:**

* Independently responsibility for at least one and occasionally multiple Data Centers.

**Performance Monitoring and Analysis:**

* Leads performance trend analyses related to capacity, temperature, availability, cleanliness, and other aspects. Identifies significant patterns, and suggests operational improvements.
* Proactively monitors facility health at all times (power, cooling, security) and develops and implements major enhancements.
* Partners across functions and regions to identify, measure, and improve processes in alignment with industry best practices (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma), lead significant improvement projects, and ensure alignment with strategic objectives.

**Issue Management and Automation:**

* Leads the on-the-ground resources to resolve incidents and performs accurate communication on execution.
* Oversees and provides support for escalated complex technical issues.
* Triages and/or escalates issues, and implements advanced automation, scheduling, and monitoring tools to mitigate potential problems effectively.
* Identifies, documents, and validates issues, processes, and solutions, ensuring the data center knowledge base is comprehensive and up-to-date.
* Prepares for, and when needed executes incident or crisis management protocols in alignment with business continuity plans.
* Performs Root Cause Analysis (RCA) following crises or incidents, and updates documentation to capture process improvements.

**Data Center Expansion Support:**

* Leads and oversees new region builds and expansion activities, both onsite and remotely.
* Acts as primary liaison with project teams and data center engineering, ensuring all timelines and capacity needs are strategically managed for expansion projects and site builds.
* Collaborates closely with project teams on critical aspects of expansion projects and site builds to deliver high standards.

**Installation and Maintenance:**

* Provides oversight for installations, repairs, inventory management, and logistics tasks.
* Directs efforts to replace and upgrade components.
* Advises on high-level purchases or upgrades for data centers and oversees implementation.
* Leads planning and execution of rack deployments, installations, and network physical infrastructure upgrades/changes.
* Ensures proactive maintenance of the Data Center facility with regard to efficiency and stability (e.g. containment, air flow & pressure, power trains).

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Title: Director, Network Development & Operations
Description:
**Xplore Inc. is Canada’s fibre, 5G and satellite broadband company for rural living. Xplore is committed to the relentless pursuit of an improved broadband experience for all Canadians. Xplore is building a world-class fibre optic and 5G wireless network to enable innovative broadband services for better every day rural living, for today and future generations.**
The Director, Network Development & Operations is the senior leader responsible for turning Xplore’s network architecture into an automated, scalable production network, delivering Core & Transport Network Services at a Tier-1 Telco Gold Standard and ensuring uncompromising reliability, security, and performance from the core to the customer. The role leads the teams accountable for detailed IP engineering, DWDM engineering automation, caching implementation, CI/CD, configuration management, telemetry, and operational tooling.
  
  
The Director sets the vision and operating model for network-as-code, ensuring that all IP/MPLS, DWDM, and caching configurations are deployed safely, consistently, and at scale. Under this leadership, the organization builds the automation frameworks, observability pipelines, and operational guardrails that enable high-velocity, low-risk changes across the backbone, reduce manual toil, and strengthen 24×7 operational readiness.
  
  
Working in close partnership with Network Architecture & Technology Strategy, the Director ensures that architectural intent is executed through modern DevOps practices, and brings operational insight back into standards, roadmaps, and long-term network evolution. The Director connects network development and operations directly to business outcomes and KPIs — including reliability, speed of change, customer experience, and cost efficiency — and serves as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on operational performance and automation maturity.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**
Detailed IP, DWDM & Caching Engineering
  
  

* Own detailed IP engineering across BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, MPLS, segment routing, and routing policy.
* Own DWDM configuration automation, including line-system configuration templates, channel provisioning, amplifier and span parameter automation, optical telemetry integration, and operational tooling for DWDM health and performance.
* Own caching platform implementation, including cache node configuration, routing and traffic-steering policies, cache peering and placement logic (as defined by Architecture), and performance tuning and hit-ratio optimization.
* Translate architectural standards into deployable configuration templates and network-as-code artifacts.

Network Automation & CI/CD Pipelines
  
  

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for IP/MPLS/DWDM and caching configuration deployment.
* Implement automated testing, validation, and rollback capabilities.
* Drive adoption of network-as-code across the Core & Transport domain, ensuring all changes are executed through automated, repeatable workflows.

Telemetry, Observability & Operational Tooling
  
  

* Own telemetry pipelines, dashboards, and observability tooling for Core & Transport.
* Ensure real-time visibility into routing behavior, caching performance and hit ratios, DWDM optical health (OSNR, span performance, and alarms), and capacity and traffic patterns.
* Partner with Service Assurance & Observability to integrate signals, alerts, anomaly detection, and automated diagnostics.

Reliability Engineering & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Implement guardrails, automated checks, and configuration validation to reduce operational risk.
* Lead post-incident automation improvements to prevent recurrence.

Partnership with Architecture & Execution of Architectural Intent
  
  

* Implement the logical connectivity, caching strategy, DWDM design parameters, standards, and principles defined by Network Architecture & Technology Strategy.
* Provide feedback loops to Architecture on operational feasibility, automation impacts, and configuration constraints.
* Ensure all deployments align with long-range architectural direction and resiliency goals.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Work closely with Network Architecture & Technology Strategy; Carrier Services; Fiber, Fixed Wireless, and Enterprise teams; and NOC, SRE, and Service Assurance.

Financial & Investment Performance
  
  

* Own the financial and investment performance of the Network Development & Operations portfolio, including capital and operating budgets, business cases, and return-on-investment tracking.
* Drive measurable unit cost improvements (e.g., cost per bit, cost per port, cost per subscriber) through automation, standardization, and platform consolidation.
* Reduce lifecycle risk by proactively managing hardware and software end-of-life and end-of-support exposure, technical debt, and refresh roadmaps across IP, DWDM, and caching platforms.
* Partner with Finance, Architecture, and Procurement to prioritize investments, optimize vendor spend, and align spending with business outcomes.
* Report on financial, unit cost, and lifecycle-risk KPIs to senior leadership.

**The Ideal Candidate Will Possess**

* 15+ years of experience in IP engineering, DWDM engineering automation, caching platforms, or DevOps for large-scale network infrastructure.

Technical Expertise
  
  

* Strong expertise in routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, IS-IS), MPLS/segment routing, and routing policy.
* Hands-on experience with DWDM systems, optical telemetry, and line-system configuration.
* Experience with caching platforms (CDN nodes, edge caches, content caches).
* Experience with automation tools (Ansible, Python, CI/CD frameworks).
* Experience with telemetry, observability, and network monitoring systems.

Leadership & Collaboration
  
  

* Demonstrated ability to lead technical engineering teams and work across Architecture, SRE, Service Assurance, and cross-functional network teams.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to translate architectural intent into executable engineering workflows.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Master’s degree considered an asset, but not required.
* Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CCNP/CCIE, DWDM/optical certifications, cloud or DevOps certifications, Agile/Scrum certifications, SRE certifications, PMP, ITIL) are considered an asset.

**Condition Of Employment**
As a condition of employment and in order to comply with industry related data security standards, this position is subject to the successful completion of a Criminal Background Check. Details will be supplied to applicants as they move through the selection process.
  
  
Xplore is committed to creating an accessible environment and will accommodate disabilities during the selection process. Please let your recruiter know during the selection process of any accommodation needs.

Title: Technical Program Manager - Multi-Hybrid Cloud Operations
Industry: IT Services and IT Consulting and Telecommunications
Description:
We are looking for an experienced
**Technical Program Manager – Multi-Hybrid Cloud Operations**
to lead the planning, transformation, governance, and delivery of complex cloud and infrastructure programs.

The successful candidate will oversee the transition and integration of public, private, sovereign, and on-premises cloud environments, ensuring seamless operations, security, reliability, cost efficiency, and service continuity.

This role requires strong technical knowledge, program leadership, and the ability to coordinate cross-functional teams, technology vendors, and senior stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end multi-hybrid cloud transformation programs, from planning and architecture through implementation, migration, and operational handover.
* Develop and manage program roadmaps, budgets, timelines, resources, milestones, risks, and delivery plans.
* Coordinate cloud engineering, infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, DevSecOps, application, and operations teams.
* Oversee cloud platforms and environments, including
  **Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), sovereign/private clouds, and on-premises infrastructure**
  .
* Govern cloud architecture, landing zones, tenant integration, connectivity, identity management, and infrastructure services.
* Ensure effective implementation of cloud operations, automation, monitoring, logging, configuration management, and infrastructure as code.
* Oversee platform operations, incident management, problem management, change management, service delivery, and technical support (L1–L3).
* Drive service reliability, availability, disaster recovery, backup, business continuity, and performance management.
* Ensure compliance with cybersecurity, data protection, data residency, regulatory, and enterprise architecture requirements.
* Lead cloud financial management (FinOps), including cost monitoring, forecasting, resource optimization, and capacity planning.
* Manage cloud service providers, managed service providers, system integrators, and technology vendors.
* Establish service-level agreements (SLAs), operational-level agreements (OLAs), service-level objectives (SLOs), governance frameworks, and operational readiness standards.
* Provide executive-level reporting on program progress, risks, financial performance, service delivery, and operational readiness.
* Lead and mentor project managers, technical leads, and cross-functional delivery teams.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field.
* Extensive experience managing complex cloud, infrastructure, platform, or digital transformation programs.
* Strong experience in multi-cloud, hybrid cloud, public cloud, private cloud, and sovereign cloud environments.
* Hands-on technical understanding of:
* **Cloud Platforms:**
  Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
* **Cloud Architecture:**
  Cloud landing zones, tenant architecture, hybrid connectivity, cloud migration, and infrastructure services.
* **Infrastructure and Networking:**
  On-premises infrastructure, network architecture, connectivity, identity federation, and infrastructure management.
* **Containers and Platforms:**
  Kubernetes, container orchestration, and platform operations.
* **Automation and DevOps:**
  Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevOps, DevSecOps, CI/CD, configuration management, and automated provisioning.
* **Monitoring and Observability:**
  Monitoring, logging, observability platforms, SIEM integration, and performance management.
* **Cybersecurity:**
  Identity and Access Management (IAM), privileged access management, vulnerability management, security posture management, data protection, and disaster recovery.
* **Cloud Operations and Management:**
  IT Service Management (ITSM), incident management, problem management, change management, service availability, and operational governance.
* **FinOps:**
  Cloud cost management, consumption monitoring, budgeting, forecasting, and resource optimization.
* Proven experience managing multi-vendor environments, program budgets, technical dependencies, and senior stakeholders.
* Experience developing operating models, governance frameworks, RACI matrices, SLAs, and operational transition plans.
* Experience in telecommunications, government, or large-enterprise environments is an advantage.

**Preferred Certifications**

* PMP, PgMP, or PRINCE2.
* ITIL Foundation or higher.
* Agile or SAFe certifications.
* Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or Oracle Cloud certifications.
* Kubernetes or cloud architecture certifications.
* FinOps certification.
* Cybersecurity or enterprise architecture certifications.

This role ensures operational excellence for compute, storage, backup, and cloud-hosted workloads, while leading managed service providers (MSPs) and internal teams to deliver reliable, secure, and compliant services at scale.

* Define and manage SLAs, SLOs, and KPIs for infrastructure services.

* Maintain audit readiness across all infrastructure domains.

* Ensure consistent operational practices across on-prem and cloud platforms.
* Optimize cloud operations for performance, and scalability.
* Partner with Cloud Platforms and Infrastructure Engineering teams on transition to operations for newly deployed services.

* Provide transparency into cost drivers, forecasting, and allocation.
* Align capacity planning with business demand and growth.

* Ensure accurate and up-to-date documentation of infrastructure services, configurations, and dependencies.
* Deliver operational dashboards and executive reporting on performance, risks, and trends.
* Provide actionable insights on capacity, utilization, and service health.

* Define clear roles and accountability between internal staff and MSPs.
* Develop leadership capability within the team, particularly in operational discipline and service management.

**Minimum Requirements:**
Education/Training –
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field; advanced degree or professional certifications in related areas preferred.

**Critical Skills:**

* 12+ years of experience in enterprise infrastructure operations, including leadership roles overseeing large-scale, hybrid (on-prem and cloud) environments.
* Strong understanding of IT financial management, including budgeting, forecasting, and cost optimization.
* Broad knowledge of enterprise infrastructure technologies, with depth in compute, storage, backup, and cloud platforms, and the ability to govern complex environments.
* Proven experience managing hybrid and cloud operations (preferably Microsoft Azure), including workload operations, cost control, and performance management.
* Solid understanding of infrastructure operations disciplines: monitoring, patching, capacity management, incident/problem/change management.

* Strong understanding of infrastructure security, risk, and compliance frameworks (e.g., SOX, SOC 1&2), including audit readiness and vulnerability remediation.
* Demonstrated experience in MSP/vendor management, including defining SLAs, driving performance, and holding partners accountable for outcomes.
* Strong leadership skills with experience building and leading operations-focused teams, including managing internal staff and external providers.
* Proven ability to drive operational excellence and service reliability in complex, large-scale environments.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively at executive and operational levels.
* Experience leading in highly complex, matrixed organizations, driving alignment across infrastructure, security, and application teams.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL / IT Service Management practices (incident, problem, change, service level management).
* Relevant certifications (cloud, ITIL, infrastructure technologies) are an asset; emphasis on operational leadership over technical specialization.

**Working Conditions:**
Environment (Office) –
  
  

* Traditional office environment.
* Hybrid work type.

Physical Requirements (Lifting, standing, etc.) –
  
  

* Large percent of time performing computer-based work is required.

Title: Vice President Service Delivery
Description:
**Position Summary**

Nuvollo is a rapidly growing managed services provider (MSP) of approximately 100 employees, delivering managed IT services including help desk, private cloud hosting (general-purpose Windows servers and ERP hosting), managed security services, professional services, AI consulting and security/governance — to small, mid-market & enterprise commercial clients across the United States and Canada. With primary offices in Cedar Knolls, New Jersey and Toronto, Ontario, a mix of US office-based/hybrid/remote & an offshore workforce providing 24x7 coverage, and growth through both organic expansion and planned tuck-in acquisitions of smaller MSPs, Nuvollo requires disciplined, scalable, and consistently excellent service delivery.

Reporting to the CEO, the
**Vice President, Service Delivery**
owns the end-to-end delivery of all managed, professional, cloud, and internal IT services. This executive leads a multi-site, cross-border organization comprising two regional Client Experience (help desk) teams (US and Canada), a Professional Services team (onboarding/offboarding, project management, project implementation, and support escalations), a Cloud Operations team (private cloud hosting in Nuvollo datacenters), and internal IT systems support and administration. The VP is accountable for client satisfaction, service quality (SLA’s), operational efficiency, service margin, and the scalability of the delivery platform — ensuring service delivery keeps pace with rapid organic and acquisition-driven growth while maintaining a unified, high-standard client experience across both countries. The VP is also responsible for full management of the Nuvollo’s PSA, RMM, and all other internal systems and plays a significant role in assisting with response to the annual SOC 2 Type 2 Audit.

This is a hands-on executive role appropriate to a ~100-person and growing organization: the VP is expected to remain close to operations, coach and develop a team of four direct leaders (plus an individual-contributor internal IT systems administrator), and personally drive key initiatives such as acquisition integration, service delivery standardization, and delivery tooling and automation. The VP, Service Delivery is an active member of the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), participating in setting the overall strategic direction of the business. They will also participate in company Board meetings monthly.

**Reporting Relationships and Organizational Context**

* **Reports to:**
  Chief Executive Officer.
* **Direct reports:**
  Toronto Regional Client Experience Manager; New Jersey Regional Client Experience Manager; Director of Professional Services; Cloud Operations Manager; Internal IT Systems Administrator.
* **Organization led:**
  Approximately 70 delivery professionals across Canada, the US, India, and Pakistan spanning help desk, professional services, cloud operations, and internal IT.
* **Peer relationships:**
  Finance/HR; Technology and Innovation (vendor/tech stack selection and solution design); Commercial (sales and marketing).
* **Locations:**
  New Jersey (primary US office), Toronto (primary Canadian office), with remote and hybrid team members across both countries, India & Pakistan.
* **Classification:**
  Full-time, executive (FLSA-exempt / Ontario-exempt); hybrid working arrangement with regular presence in the New Jersey and Toronto offices and periodic travel between sites, datacenters, and acquired-company locations. Note: Travel cross-border between US and Canada is expected to be no more than 1-2x per quarter.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

***Service Delivery Leadership and Operational Excellence***

* Own the full lifecycle of service delivery across all service lines and both countries. Partner with Tech & Innovation team to establish and enforce standardized, documented, and repeatable delivery processes, standard operating procedures, and a consistent service catalog across US and Canadian operations. Ensure services are delivered on time, on budget, and to contractual SLA and quality standards.

***Client Experience and Satisfaction***

* Champion a client-first, high sense of urgency culture across both regional help desk teams. Ensure consistent, high-quality, 24x7-responsive support for clients globally, with clear escalation paths from tier-1 through professional services. Own the client satisfaction program — surveys, complaint resolution, and churn-risk intervention — including partnering with VP Commercial for retention strategies for at-risk accounts, and growth strategies for strategic accounts.

***SLA and Service Level Management***

* Define, negotiate (with Commercial), monitor, and consistently meet/exceed client SLAs and internal operational targets. Maintain robust service level reporting, breach and failure root-cause analysis, and corrective action programs. Ensure contractual commitments are realistic, profitable, and operationally achievable across time zones and borders.

***Cloud Operations and Infrastructure Reliability***

* Directly accountable, through the Cloud Operations Manager, for the private cloud hosting business: datacenter operations, Windows server and ERP hosting platforms, proper licensing, capacity planning, high availability, disaster recovery, backup integrity, and infrastructure security posture. Ensure platform reliability, uptime, governance and cost efficiency that support both client commitments and healthy service margins.

***Professional Services and Onboarding Excellence***

* Through the Director of Professional Services, own client onboarding and offboarding, project management, and professional services for project implementation. Drive fast, high-quality, consistent and standardized low-risk onboarding that accelerates time-to-value and revenue recognition, and ensure projects are delivered on time, on budget, and with high client acceptance. Own the escalation framework from the help desk teams into professional services and engineering resources. Own Project Management Office (PMO) for all all internal and client facing projects.

***Acquisition Integration and Scalable Growth***

* Lead the service delivery dimension of tuck-in MSP acquisitions: due diligence on delivery operations, integration planning and execution, standardization of tooling, processes, and service catalogs, retention of key technical and service staff, and rapid migration of acquired clients onto Nuvollo platforms and SLAs — while protecting the client experience of both acquired and existing clients.
* Active participant in pre-acquisition diligence and post-acquisition integration efforts.

***Team Leadership, Development, and Cross-Border Management***

* Build, coach, and retain a high-performing, engaged, dispersed delivery organization across the US, Canada, India and Pakistan. Set clear goals and accountability for direct reports; develop succession plans and career paths; foster a unified culture across geographic and national boundaries; and manage performance, hiring, and staffing levels to meet demand. Ensure effective scheduling, coverage, and workload balancing across time zones.

* ***Financial and Capacity Management***

Own the service delivery staffing budget. Partner with Finance on revenue recognition, project accounting, and cost allocation; partner with Commercial on scoping, pricing, and serviceability of new deals; partner with Tech & Innovation team on identification and definition of new services and standardized implementation and delivery processes, vendor partners and tech stack tools.

***Process Improvement, Automation, and AI Enablement***

* Drive continuous improvement across all delivery functions using metrics, root-cause analysis, and client feedback. Champion automation, AI-assisted support tooling, and self-service capabilities to improve response times, reduce cost-to-serve, and scale delivery capacity ahead of growth. Partner with Technology and Innovation on tooling and platform selection and on embedding AI consulting and governance practices into delivery.

***Security, Compliance, and Risk Management***

* Ensure delivery operations meet client contractual, regulatory, and cybersecurity obligations across both jurisdictions (e.g., cyber insurance requirements, privacy laws such as PIPEDA and state privacy statutes, and frameworks such as SOC 2 where applicable). Own operational incident and major outage management, including client communications, post-incident reviews, and remediation. Partner with Tech and Innovation leadership to ensure the security of Nuvollo’s own environment and hosted client infrastructure.

**Qualifications and Experience**

***Required***

* 10+ years of progressive experience in IT service delivery, managed services, or IT operations, including 5+ years in senior leadership roles within an MSP, hosting provider, or comparable IT services environment.
* Proven leadership of multi-site, dispersed teams of 40+, with demonstrated success managing remote/hybrid organizations across time zones and national borders.
* Deep working knowledge of IT service management frameworks (ITIL), help desk operations, cloud/hosted infrastructure (Windows Server, virtualization, ERP hosting), and managed security service operations.
* Strong command of service metrics and reporting (SLAs, CSAT/NPS, MTTR, utilization) and experience running data-driven operational reviews.
* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, business, or equivalent practical experience.

***Preferred***

* Experience serving mid-market commercial clients in regulated or ERP-heavy environments.
* Demonstrated P&L or budget ownership, with a track record of managing service margins, utilization, and capacity planning.
* Direct experience with service delivery aspects of M&A integration (tuck-in acquisitions preferred) and with scaling operations through rapid growth.
* Familiarity with privacy and compliance regimes in both the US and Canada (PIPEDA, state privacy laws, cyber insurance requirements, SOC 2).
* Exposure to AI-assisted service delivery tooling, automation platforms, and AI consulting practices.
* Relevant certifications such as ITIL Expert/Managing Professional, PMP, CISSP, or equivalent.

Core Competencies

Description:

Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.
  
  
**Senior Director, Network Operations**
**About The Role**
The Senior Director of Network Operations is a strategic and transformational leadership role responsible for evolving the network operations organization into a modern, automation-driven, and highly reliable function. This leader will drive the maturation of people, process, and technology while delivering resilient, scalable, and business-aligned network services.
  
  
The role partners closely with Network Engineering, Security, Application Teams, and Business Stakeholders to ensure operational excellence, accelerate innovation through automation and AI, and continuously improve service quality and user experience.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Organizational Transformation & Maturity**

* Lead the transformation of Network Operations into a proactive, data-driven, and automation-first organization
* Establish and execute a multi-year maturity roadmap across people, process, and technology
* Standardize operating models, governance, and service delivery frameworks (e.g., ITIL-based practices)
* Build a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence

**Automation, AI, and Operational Innovation**

* Drive adoption of automation (NetDevOps, AIOps, self-healing capabilities) to reduce manual effort and improve reliability
* Leverage AI/ML for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and incident prevention
* Implement intelligent observability and event correlation to enhance signal-to-noise ratio
* Champion “zero-touch” operations and continuous optimization of operational workflows

**Service Delivery & Foundational Capabilities**

* Own the delivery and continuous improvement of core network services (LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, Cloud Networking, Data Center Connectivity, Edge)
* Define and manage service catalogs, SLAs/XLAs, and performance metrics
* Ensure scalability, resiliency, and availability aligned with business requirements
* Drive service standardization and simplification to improve adoption and supportability

**Incident, Change, and Problem Management**

* Establish best-in-class Incident, Change, and Problem Management disciplines
* Reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR) through tooling, automation, and process optimization
* Lead major incident response, including executive communications and root cause accountability
* Drive systemic problem management to eliminate recurring issues and improve stability
* Partner with engineering to ensure effective change planning, risk mitigation, and release quality

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Collaborate with Network Engineering to operationalize new technologies and ensure supportability by design
* Partner with Security teams to maintain compliance, risk posture, and incident response alignment
* Engage application and business teams to align network services with business outcomes and user experience goals
* Act as a key interface between operations, product owners, and executive stakeholders.

**People Leadership & Talent Development**

* Build and lead a high-performing global team with a focus on capability development and future-ready skills
* Drive talent strategy, including upskilling in automation, cloud networking, and AI-driven operations
* Foster a culture of empowerment, innovation, and continuous learning
* Align team objectives with organizational priorities and measurable outcomes

**Metrics, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement**

* Define and track KPIs/KRIs to measure operational performance, service quality, and transformation progress
* Provide executive-level reporting on operational health, risks, and improvement initiatives
* Use data-driven insights to prioritize investments and drive continuous improvement
* Benchmark capabilities against industry best practices
* Other duties may be assigned as needed to meet Company goals

**Minimum Qualification**

* 12+ years in IT/Network Operations, with 5+ years in senior leadership roles
* Proven track record of leading large-scale operational transformation programs
* Experience implementing automation, AIOps, or similar advanced operational capabilities
* Strong background in enterprise network environments (on-prem, cloud, hybrid)

**Preferred Skills**

* Deep understanding of ITIL frameworks (Incident, Problem, Change Management)
* Experience with observability platforms, automation tools, and network management systems
* Strong business and stakeholder engagement skills
* Ability to align technical operations with strategic business objectives
* Data-driven mindset with focus on measurable outcomes

**Leadership Competencies**

* Strategic thinker with execution discipline
* Change agent with the ability to influence across organizational boundaries
* Strong communicator with executive presence
* Focused on outcomes, simplification, and continuous improvement

**Success Measures**

* Measurable reduction in MTTR, incident volume, and repeat issues
* Increased automation coverage and reduced manual intervention
* Improved service reliability and customer satisfaction (SLAs/XLAs)
* Successful deployment of AI-driven operations capabilities
* Enhanced team engagement, capability growth, and retention.

Title: Senior Service Delivery Manager
Description:
Who We Are
  
  
Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.
  
  
**Vultr Cares**

* 100% company-paid insurance premiums for employee medical, dental and vision plans.
* 401(k) plan that matches 100% up to 4%, with immediate vesting
* Professional Development Reimbursement of $2,500 each year
* 11 Holidays + Paid Time Off Accrual + Rollover Plan
* Commitment matters to Vultr! Increased PTO at 3 year and 10 year anniversary + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year
* $500 stipend for remote office setup in first year + $400 each following year
* Internet reimbursement up to $75 per month
* Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month
* Company paid Wellable subscription

**Join Vultr**
Vultr is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Service Delivery Manager to lead delivery for our most strategic customers. You will be a customer-facing program manager for large, complex AI infrastructure programs that run for many months and involve many teams across Vultr, as well as partners and suppliers. You will be the customer's primary point of contact for delivery, represent their priorities inside Vultr, and make sure what we commit to deliver is what they receive. The engineering and operations teams own and run their work; you connect it into a single delivery view for the customer and keep it moving. You will also lead cross-functional initiatives that improve how Vultr operates.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a seasoned program leader with a record of delivering large infrastructure programs for demanding enterprise customers, who earns the trust of executives and engineers alike. This is a highly visible role in a high-growth technology company, which will require sound judgment under pressure, candid communication when plans change, and the ability to lead teams you don't manage. You'll work on some of the largest AI infrastructure programs Vultr has ever taken on, in close partnership with senior leadership. Service Delivery is a new function at Vultr, so you will also help shape how it works. This is your opportunity to join our fast growing team and leave your mark on Vultr and the future of Cloud Infrastructure.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery for one to two concurrent strategic customer programs, from the late stages of the sale through go-live and stable operation.
* Own the customer relationship for delivery as primary contact and accountable owner, running executive governance such as steering committees, regular delivery reviews and escalations.
* Partner with sales and account management before contract signature to confirm that what we commit to is deliverable, then make sure every commitment is tracked and met.
* Coordinate the work of multiple engineering, infrastructure and operations teams, each with its own program managers, without taking over their plans: understand the dependencies between them, spot risks early and drive resolution.
* Advocate for the customer inside Vultr, making sure their priorities shape decisions and challenging delays that can be avoided.
* Communicate schedule changes to customers early and honestly, and lead difficult conversations about dates and scope with customer executives.
* Manage each customer's path, from sales to delivery to ongoing support, leading formal customer acceptance once the service is live, ensuring nothing promised to the customer is lost along the way.
* Lead cross-functional internal initiatives that improve how Vultr serves its customers, from planning through to a measurable outcome.
* Coach Service Delivery Managers and build the methods, templates and standards the team uses.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of program or project management experience, including at least 5 years managing customer-facing delivery of large, complex technology programs in cloud, data center, HPC, AI or telecommunications.
* Proven ability to lead through influence across engineering, operations and commercial teams you don't manage.
* Executive presence, including experience running steering committees and holding difficult conversations with senior customer stakeholders.
* Solid grasp of infrastructure delivery (data centers, networking, servers and GPUs, storage), enough to ask engineers the right questions and judge the answers.
* Sound judgment under pressure, with a habit of raising risks early and bringing options rather than waiting for problems to escalate.
* Experience moving customers from project delivery into ongoing operations and support.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, from detailed working sessions to executive summaries.
* Proficiency with Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence and Salesforce, or similar program management, collaboration and CRM tools.
* Ability to travel up to 25% to customer sites and data centers.
* Flexibility to work extended hours, including some weekends, around major customer launches and across customer time zones.
* Preferred: PMP, PgMP or equivalent certification; experience building a new delivery function or practice.

**Compensation**
$150,000 - $160,000
  
  
*Final compensation will vary depending on years of experience, background/skill set, location, and applicable laws.*
**Inclusion & Privacy**
We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.

Title: Technical Program Manager-Data Center
Description:
**About the Role:**

The Technical Program Manager administers the qualification and validation of new products, and of retrofits and engineering changes to existing parts, for use in large-scale data center environments. The program spans inside plant (ISP) and outside plant (OSP) optical fiber cable, connectivity, and pathway products from candidate identification through validated, released configuration. The position owns the technical content of the program: product selection and evaluation criteria, test methodology, acceptance limits, measurement integrity, and the qualification record that supports product approval and release. The Technical Program Manager serves as the technical interface between design engineering, construction and installation crews, component manufacturers, and test equipment suppliers, and is accountable for validated, documented, and field-reproducible connectivity products on schedule.

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Validation Program Planning and Execution:** Develop and own integrated validation program plans covering both new product introduction and retrofits or engineering changes to existing parts — qualification sequence, entry and exit criteria, material and laboratory dependencies, and decision gates — holding the critical path and driving programs to documented closure.
* **Inside Plant and Outside Plant Infrastructure:** Manage ISP structured cabling across backbone and horizontal distribution, riser and plenum pathways, main and intermediate distribution frames (MDF/IDF), cabinet and rack-mounted patch fields, fiber distribution frames, splice and termination enclosures, cassette-based modular patching, cable tray, basket and innerduct pathway, and firestopping and pathway segregation; and OSP placement across duct bank and conduit, microduct and air-blown fiber, maintenance holes and handholes, aerial and direct-buried routes, building entrance facilities and points of entry (MPOE), transition splice points, armored and dielectric constructions, and environmental and ingress protection at the ISP/OSP demarcation.
* **Fiber Cable, Connectivity, and Termination Scope:** Qualify single-mode (OS2, 9/125 µm) and multimode cable across the full range of standard counts in general industry use, from 24-fiber distribution cable through 3456-fiber high-count backbone, in loose tube, central core, ribbon, rollable ribbon, and 200/250 µm coating designs, evaluating diameter, bend radius, pulling tension, duct fill, and mid-span access against pathway and installation constraints. Own connectivity across LC and LC duplex, MTP/MPO single-row and dual-row arrays (8, 12, 16, and 24 fiber), and very-high-density MMC arrays (16 and 24 fiber), including pinned (male) and unpinned (female) configurations, UPC and APC endface geometries, gender and key orientation, and polarity schemes spanning TIA-568 Method A, B, and C and the conventions applicable to multi-row arrays. Define and validate patch panel, cassette, adapter plate, and shelf configurations for port density, fiber management, bend radius protection, slack storage, labeling access, and serviceability, and evaluate breakout, fanout, harness, trunk, and pigtail assemblies against port mapping and channel performance requirements.
* **Test, Measurement, and Acceptance:** Establish and govern optical test programs — Tier 1 optical loss test set (OLTS) insertion loss and return loss certification, Tier 2 OTDR characterization, bidirectional testing, length and continuity verification, polarity and fitment verification, and endface inspection and cleaning to recognized criteria such as IEC 61300-3-35 — controlling test reference cord (TRC) grade, referencing method, and calibration state so results are repeatable and defensible. Reconcile measured channel performance against design acceptance criteria and transceiver link specifications, and drive corrective action where acceptance limits are not met.
* **Supplier Qualification and Test Equipment Capability:** Lead technical qualification of cable, connectivity, and pathway manufacturers through sample submission, first-article inspection, mechanical and optical evaluation, failure analysis, root cause determination, and corrective action closure, maintaining a defensible qualification record and a clear statement of remaining gaps per supplier. Evaluate, select, and introduce fiber test and inspection platforms end to end, covering technical evaluation against requirements, procurement support, asset control and inventory, calibration and reference cord management, operator training, and fleet distribution to regional field crews.
* **Documentation and Standards:** Produce and sustain installation work instructions, test procedures, golden samples, first-of-kind build documentation, labeling and administration schemes, and as-built records, maintaining them so methods are applied consistently by field crews and subcontractors without procedural drift.
* **Program Governance and Risk Management:** Maintain accurate program status, ownership, target dates, and documented reasons for schedule movement, and produce recurring technical status reporting for client and internal leadership, surfacing aging, blocked, and unassigned work rather than allowing it to persist. Identify technical, schedule, supply chain, and capability risks in advance, quantify impact, drive mitigation to a named owner and committed date, and escalate with a recommendation.
* **Safety and Regulatory Compliance:** Champion a zero-injury culture in laboratory and field environments, ensuring personnel and subcontractors understand and apply laser safety, confined space, excavation, aerial work, and fiber handling requirements, and that work complies with OSHA and other applicable regulations and site access requirements.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Knowledge and use of basic telecom hand tools.
* Must understand customer service.
* Cleared understanding of job safety requirements.
* Should be familiar on wiring schemes and wiring test.
* Reports to Operations Manager and take daily directions from Technician, Technician II, Lead Technicians, Senior Technicians and Advance Senior Technicians.
* Perform 4 pair continuity testing
* Pull all types of low voltage cable including copper telecom cable
* Performing all types of copper field terminations
* Install ladder racking and seismic bracing
* Patch network equipment
* Read and Understand Port Maps/Matrices
* Read and understand job floor plan and TC drawings
* Should understand and be capable in performing field terminations and labeling.
* Install Copper and Fiber Cabling and labeling
* Affixing Labels to cabling and Power Cords
* Affix bar coding to equipment
* Affix free printed label
* Cut and install threaded rod
* Cut and install Uni-strut
* Cut and install fiber trough
* Create/test Bonding whips, straps, and connections
* Understand the basics of "FIM" and operate scanner
* Install and test coax cabling (series 6 & 11)
* Install OSP cables through conduits and maintenance
* Install pull strings through conduits, in ceilings
* Install ISP cables through conduits, in ceilings,

* How to install/maintain firestopping

Title: Senior Service Delivery Manager
Description:
At Ensono, our Purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things! We enable our clients to achieve key business outcomes that reshape how our world runs. As an expert technology adviser and managed service provider with cross-platform certifications, Ensono empowers our clients to keep up with continuous change and embrace innovation.

Honesty, Reliability, Curiosity, Collaboration, and Passion.

About the role and what you'll be doing:

The Senior Service Delivery Manager (SDM) is the primary operational advocate and advisor for assigned clients. Working across Ensono delivery, support, and account teams, the SDM ensures contracted services meet client expectations, service commitments, and desired business outcomes. This role leads service governance, performance management, escalations, risk management, and continuous improvement across complex, multi-service environments.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

 

* Own end-to-end service delivery for assigned complex, multi-service accounts, ensuring SLAs, SLOs, KPIs, and contractual commitments are met.
* Serve as the primary operational contact and trusted advisor for client stakeholders, partnering with the Client Executive and delivery teams.
* Lead weekly operational reviews, MBRs, QBRs, and executive briefings; translate service data into clear business insights and recommendations.
* Lead major incident governance, escalations, root cause reviews, and corrective action plans with timely, audience-appropriate communication.
* Oversee change, release, and maintenance coordination, representing the client perspective and minimizing business disruption.
* Maintain governance artifacts, risk registers, Service Improvement Plans, audit readiness, and compliance with Ensono and client requirements.
* Manage account financial activities, including budget tracking, forecasting, billing validation, consumption reporting, cost optimization, and identification of growth opportunities.
* Use performance trends, client feedback, and Ensono Portal insights to prioritize continuous improvement, automation, resilience, security, and cost-efficiency initiatives.

* Proficient use of AI tools, prompting, and agents to improve productivity and client insights.
* Strong executive presentation and public-speaking skills, with the ability to communicate technical topics to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to mentor colleagues and contribute to service delivery best practices.

* ITIL certification and experience supporting client onboarding or service transitions.

Ensono is a place to make better happen – for our clients and for your career. Title: IT Director, Infrastructure & Operations
Description:
Join the largest manufacturer of tile and natural stone in the United States and watch your career stand out with Dal-Tile, a subsidiary of Mohawk Industries.
  
  
Our close-knit team of dedicated professionals has made us the success we are today. In exchange for their hard work, we support our people with a family-friendly work environment, a commitment to promoting from within, unique benefits that go beyond just medical and dental, and a belief that every employee deserves a productive life outside of work. If this sounds outstanding to you, take the first step forward and explore a career with Dal-Tile.
  
  
The
**IT Director, Infrastructure & Operations**
provides strategic and operational leadership for Dal-Tile’s infrastructure and technology operations, with accountability for infrastructure strategy, governance, portfolio prioritization, financial management, service performance, and operational resilience. The role serves as the primary business partner for infrastructure demand and service outcomes, aligning infrastructure investments with application roadmaps and business priorities.
  
  
The Director oversees infrastructure portfolio intake and prioritization with the Mohawk Global Infrastructure PMO, budget and funding, major incident and outage management, service levels, disaster recovery, compliance, vendor performance, and chronic issue resolution. The role also leads the Application Managed Services (AMS) partnership, monitoring and observability, Tier 1.5/2 production support, and AI technology enablement, while driving modernization, automation, stability, and continuous improvement.
  
  

* This role does NOT provide current or future sponsorship assistance

* Employees are required to report in office 4 days a week / 7834 CF Hawn Freeway | Dallas, Texas 75217 (NO NEGOTIATION)
* This is a direct hire role; We are NOT open to employing through contractor or agency

**Duties And Responsibilities Of The Position**

* Infrastructure Strategy & Planning: Provide strategic input into Dal-Tile's infrastructure direction and multiyear roadmap by identifying emerging technology opportunities, future capacity and lifecycle needs, and opportunities for modernization, automation, and innovation. Partner with Global Infrastructure teams to align BU requirements with enterprise technology direction.

Manage BU infrastructure intake, sequencing, and prioritization with the Global Infrastructure PMO and ensure infrastructure requirements are identified and aligned with application roadmaps, business priorities, scope, and timing.
