Description:
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.
  
  
As a Delivery Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will oversee the technical delivery of an enterprise Azure managed services engagement for a US financial services client, lead cross-functional and global teams and mentor junior members. You will own the day-to-day service relationship, drive SLA and compliance performance, and support estimation, planning and change orders to ensure successful outcomes.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
We are looking for a Delivery Manager to own the delivery of a three-year Azure managed services engagement. You will be the accountable point of contact for the client, leading the teams that Migrate, transition, operate and secure a mix of Azure workloads, including compute and operating systems, containers, serverless services, backup and disaster recovery, patching, vulnerability and security monitoring, and cost optimization
  
  
As a Delivery Manager, you will be the onshore Service Delivery Manager for a multi-year Azure managed services contract covering a mix of IaaS (several hundred virtual machines across production, non-production and disaster recovery) and PaaS/serverless services. You will lead Level 2 and Level 3 operations teams across onshore and offshore Delivery centres, run service governance with the client, and ensure the Migrate, Transition and Operate phases are delivered against contractual SLAs, security standards and cost commitments.
  
  
**Service Delivery & Contract Governance**

* Own end-to-end delivery across Plan & Define, Transition, and Operate (including the 90-day stabilization period), and maintain the Service Delivery Plan (SDP) as a living document.
* Deliver against contractual SLAs - incident response/resolution, VM availability, and DR RTO/RPO - reporting monthly and running governance forums (service reviews, optimization reviews, steering committee).
* Control scope and commercials: flag out-of-scope requests, raise change orders, and act as the escalation point for Priority 1 incidents.

**Azure IaaS & PaaS Operations Oversight**

* Oversee Level 2/3 support for Azure IaaS (VMs, networking, storage, firewalls/WAF, load balancing) and PaaS/serverless services, including the shared-responsibility boundary with Microsoft.
* Ensure golden, CIS-hardened images and IaC templates are maintained and used for all deployments, and oversee CI/CD, key/secrets management, and tagging standards.
* Coordinate with Microsoft support and the client on CSP-side incidents and platform maintenance.

**Incident, Problem & Change Management**

* Run ITIL-aligned incident, problem, and change management through ServiceNow - including the bidirectional eBonding integration - ensuring SLA-compliant prioritization (P1-P4) and root cause analysis for every P1.
* Govern change requests (standard/normal/emergency) including CAB approvals, and maintain clear hand-offs across client Level 0/1, Deloitte Level 2/3, and third parties.

**Security, Compliance & Risk**

* Ensure operational security controls are effective - IAM (SSO/MFA/PAM), credential rotation, and annual access reviews.
* Oversee vulnerability management (daily scanning, risk prioritization, monthly reporting), SIEM/log monitoring, and security incident response.
* Oversee cloud security posture management and compliance against NIST/CIS/CSA baselines, and support client audits and control requests.

**Backup, Disaster Recovery & Patching**

* Oversee backup/restore policies across block, object, file, and PaaS data; plan and oversee the annual DR fail-over/fail-back test, reporting measured RPO/RTO.
* Oversee the monthly OS patching cycle and CSP platform maintenance, communicating schedule and impacting the client.

**Transition, Automation & Observability**

* Lead transition into managed services - design workshops, solution documentation, tool deployment, and knowledge transfer to steady-state operations.
* Ensure monitoring/alerting/log management are configured to agreed thresholds, drive automation and continuous improvement (tracking MTTR and incident volume), and maintain client-facing reporting.

**FinOps & Financial Management**

* Define budget thresholds and track alerts; oversee the quarterly cloud optimization analysis and reservation/savings-plan reviews.
* Own delivery P&L inputs (utilization, productivity, revenue leakage) and partner with account leadership on renewals and extensions.

**People & Team Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and coach technical leads and engineers across onshore and offshore Global Cloud Operations centers, including 24x7 on-call coverage for Priority 1 incidents.
* Manage capacity planning, staffing, and on-call models, and support career development, certification paths, and promotion readiness.

**The Team:**
At Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, we deliver solutions spanning Hybrid Cloud, Advanced Connectivity, AI Data Centers, High-Performance Computing and AI Infrastructure to help clients achieve their desired outcomes. Our offerings include engineered transformation services for hybrid cloud infrastructure and platforms, prioritizing resiliency, optimization, and extensive automation. We integrate advanced connectivity with AI infrastructure and enterprise networks to boost operational efficiency and enable real-time data processing. Additionally, we provide comprehensive management of all facets of operations for hybrid cloud infrastructure and field operations.
  
  
This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.
  
  
The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 10+ years in IT infrastructure services delivery, including 5+ years delivering Azure solutions.
* 3+ years as a delivery manager, service delivery manager or technical lead on an SLA-driven managed services engagement.
* Strong working knowledge of Azure IaaS: Windows and Linux VMs, VMSS, virtual networks, NSGs, Azure Firewall/WAF, load balancers, managed disks and storage, Entra ID and Key Vault.
* Working knowledge of Azure PaaS and serverless services (such as App Service, Functions and managed databases), including how operational responsibilities differ from IaaS.
* Understanding of backup and disaster recovery on Azure (Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery), RPO/RTO objectives and DR testing.
* Strong command of ITIL and ServiceNow, including incident, problem and change management, SLA reporting and ticketing integrations.
* Understanding of cloud security operations: vulnerability management, SIEM, endpoint protection, security posture management, IAM/PAM/MFA, and CIS and NIST controls.
* Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD (Terraform or Bicep; Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) and Windows/Linux patch management.
* Familiarity with monitoring and log management tools (such as Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or Datadog).
* Experience with cloud cost management, including budget alerts, optimization reviews and reservations.
* Commercial acumen across SOWs, SLAs, change orders and delivery financials.
* Strong stakeholder and executive communication skills, including client governance and escalation handling.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
* Ability to travel 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

**Preferred**

* Exposure to container platforms and Kubernetes operations (such as AKS).
* Cloud certifications (Azure preferred) and ITIL 4 certification are an advantage.
* Experience in banking or financial services is an advantage.

Title: Director of Service Delivery - Remote
Description:
FusionTek is a growing managed services provider (MSP), and our Service Team is where our reputation is made. As
**Director of Service Delivery**
, you’ll lead the people who deliver it every day — the Reactive Service Team, the Escalated Service Team, and our Service Coordination Team.
  
  
You’ll report directly to the COO, own the service delivery engine of the company, and play a major role in whether we hit our aggressive growth goals. This role is built to evolve and grow as we do, if you want a seat where your impact is visible, this is it.
  
  
**Why MSP Experience Matters**
Prior MSP Help Desk leadership experience is strongly preferred. Leading service delivery in an MSP is significantly different from managing an internal IT department. An MSP supports multiple clients at the same time, each with different environments, priorities, SLAs, and expectations.
  
  
The Director of Service must be able to manage technician capacity, ticket queues, escalations, service levels, documentation, client satisfaction, and operational KPIs across multiple accounts simultaneously. We are looking for someone who already understands the pace and complexity of an MSP Help Desk and can step into the role ready to lead, improve, and scale the service organization.
  
  
**Why FusionTek?**
We’re Not a Startup Guessing Our Way Through, We’ve Spent 20 Years Building Something That Works, And We’re Just Getting Started. The Industry Has Noticed
  
  

* Inc. 5000 — Fastest Growing Private Companies in America
* MSP 501 — ranked among the top managed service providers worldwide
* Inc. Regionals Award — Pacific Northwest
* CRN MSP 500 — Pioneer 250 list

But the awards aren’t why people stay. They stay for the culture: team luncheons and employee events that actually feel like events, leadership that knows your name, and a company that shows up for the community — sponsoring and participating in local causes that matter to our team members. We work hard, we win together, and we make sure the wins are felt.
  
  
We’re also serious about staying ahead of the curve. We’re investing heavily in
**AI modernization**
— putting modern AI-powered tooling in our teams’ hands so technicians spend less time on repetitive work and more time solving real problems. When our people say they have the tools to get the job done, we take it seriously: if a tool makes the team faster and the client experience better, we build it, buy it, or adopt it.
  
  
And because we’re growing fast, this Director role isn’t a ceiling; it’s a launch pad. You’ll report directly to the COO and help shape how service delivery scales across the company.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and develop the Service Team — direct day-to-day management of the Reactive, Escalated, and Service Coordination teams, including staffing, ticket life-cycle, and workload balancing by role and skill level.
* Own escalations end to end — make sure tickets escalate into and within Escalated Service (and to other FusionTek teams) correctly, using our SLA matrix to keep every ticket prioritized right.
* Drive the metrics that matter — manage the department to target KPIs for resolution time, CSAT, time spent, and more, and report weekly on service trends and Escalated Service metrics to the CEO.
* Keep the on-call rotation healthy — maintain the On-Call Escalated rotation and coordinate with the Service Desk Manager so coverage is always sufficient.
* Build and improve the playbook — create, update, and enforce the processes our Service Team runs on, keeping everything documented, audited, and regularly improved.
* Drive efficiency and protect margins — keep tickets moving and technicians focused, so time is spent where it creates value: ensuring a minimum of 6.5 billable hours logged per 8-hour shift, catching tickets that quietly over-consume time, and preserving both profitability and the client experience.
* Be the connector — partner with projects team, client account management, and sales so the Service Team and the whole company run smoothly and build client relationships that strengthen FusionTek’s reputation for technical excellence.
* Grow your people — conduct and share Service Team performance reviews through Weekly L10s, Quarterly Conversations, and annual reviews using our defined processes. Our goal: voluntary turnover under 5% annually.

**Requirements**
**Technical Skills & Qualifications**

* 5+ years in IT roles, including hands-on technical work in an MSP or service desk environment, with 3+ years in a leadership or supervisory role
* Hands-on experience with Autotask or a similar PSA (we use Autotask and MSPbots to monitor ticket loads and progress)
* A solid technical foundation in a stack like ours — Microsoft 365, Azure/Entra ID, Windows Server, networking fundamentals, and Datto BCDR. Direct experience with these exact technologies isn’t required, but comparable hands-on knowledge is: you can hold your own in a technical conversation, understand root causes well enough to challenge a resolution plan, and know when an escalation is heading the wrong direction
* Exceptional written and verbal communication — you can talk to technicians, clients, and the CEO with equal clarity
* A calm head under pressure: you manage multiple priorities, resolve conflict fairly, and solve problems before they become fires
* A team-first mindset — you give and accept feedback sincerely and put the team’s success above your own
* Self-motivated and curious; you enjoy learning new things
* A valid driver’s license and reliable, insured vehicle
* Industry certifications strongly preferred (e.g., Microsoft, CompTIA, or similar); additional certification requirements to be agreed upon during the hiring process
* High school diploma required; bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred

**Benefits**
At
**FusionTek**
, we truly believe our people are our most valuable asset. That’s why we’re proud to offer:
  
  

* Competitive salary: $120k - $150k/year
* Bonus structure tied to personal and departmental KPIs — up to 4% per quarter plus an additional 5% annually
* Comprehensive coverage: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
* 401(k) plan with 4% company matching and immediate vesting
* Time Off That Actually Lets You Recharge: Generous PTO, Paid company holidays, Dedicated Birthday PTO and 2 additional floating holidays for extra flexibility
* Monthly cell phone stipend to support your connectivity needs
* Team culture: Fun events and opportunities to connect with colleagues

**What You'll Do**

**Why You'll Love It**

* Leadership experience managing technical teams and large-scale infrastructure initiatives

**Minimum Qualifications**
EXPERIENCE, TRAINING, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES
  
  
**Required Minimum Qualifications**

* Possess a Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college or university with a major in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Engineering, or related field.
* Have had at least eight (8) years of full-time experience in information technology involving systems software, systems analysis, or technical infrastructure; including two (2) years in a technical leader or supervisory capacity.

**Additional Desirable Qualifications**

* Considerable knowledge of local and wide area networking, network management, structured cabling systems, fiber optics, client/server, operating systems, computer hardware, software, system design/analysis, programming, training, and support.
* Extensive knowledge of current hardware and software technologies and uses.
* Hands-on experience troubleshooting hardware such as servers, routers, bridges, switches, hubs, modems, and network interface cards.

* Demonstrated ability to adapt to emerging technologies, evolving business needs, and dynamic network environments.

* Instructs, assigns, schedules, checks, and appraises performance.

**Essential Job Functions**

* Ensures fiber plans are maintained in cost effective manners while providing high availability and redundancy for all network, telephony, and radio activities.

**Commercial & Consultative Skills**

* Proven ability to facilitate executive ideation sessions and build AI transformation strategies and roadmaps with senior leadership.
* Ability to build compelling business cases and turn technical value into commercial outcomes.
* Excellent executive presence; confident presenting to ministers, deputy ministers and the C-suite.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Saudi national.
* Fluent Arabic and English, written and spoken.
* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
* Professional cloud/architecture certifications (e.g. Azure, AWS or GCP architect); TOGAF is a plus.
* An existing network across Saudi government entities and telecom operators.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Executive AI strategy engagements led and converted into opportunities.
* Presales win rate and total contract value influenced.
* Pipeline generated in the Government and Telco sectors.
* Quality and on-time submission of proposals and RFP responses.
* Client satisfaction and repeat business from key accounts.
* Team capability growth (certifications, retention, bench strength).

****THE SEAT****

* Location: Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
* Reports to: Head of Government & Telco
* Employment type: Full-time
* Target sectors: Government & Public Sector; Telecommunications

* Customer first: You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritise accordingly.
* Ownership mentality: You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix.
* Clear communicator: You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and you enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet.
* Long-term builder: You invest in Echelon’s long-term success, bringing field insight back into our strategy and operations.
* Builds others: You measure yourself by the people you develop and the capability you build with customers.

****HOW WE WORK****
You start from the problem, not the tool. You meet an unclear brief or a broken environment with energy and a plan.

* Speed: You move from brief to a first working result quickly and do not wait for perfect conditions.

* Resourcefulness: Missing access, partial data, an unfamiliar organisation: you find a way with what is available.
* Situational leadership: You lead when the moment calls for it, and follow when someone else has the better call.
* A force multiplier: Your playbooks, reviews and coaching make the whole bench faster.

Title: Director of Service Delivery - Tampa
Description:
FusionTek is a growing managed services provider (MSP), and our Service Team is where our reputation is made. As
**Director of Service Delivery**
, you'll lead the people who deliver it every day — the Reactive Service Team, the Escalated Service Team, and our Service Coordination Team.
  
  
You'll report directly to the COO, own the service delivery engine of the company, and play a major role in whether we hit our aggressive growth goals. This role is built to evolve and grow as we do, if you want a seat where your impact is visible, this is it. This role will
**require a Hybrid schedule**
with at least two in-office days per week, based in our
**Tampa, FL**
office.
  
  
**Why MSP Experience Matters**
Prior MSP Help Desk leadership experience is strongly preferred. Leading service delivery in an MSP is significantly different from managing an internal IT department. An MSP supports multiple clients at the same time, each with different environments, priorities, SLAs, and expectations.
  
  
The Director of Service must be able to manage technician capacity, ticket queues, escalations, service levels, documentation, client satisfaction, and operational KPIs across multiple accounts simultaneously. We are looking for someone who already understands the pace and complexity of an MSP Help Desk and can step into the role ready to lead, improve, and scale the service organization.
  
  
**Why FusionTek?**
We're not a startup guessing our way through, we've spent
**20 years**
building something that works, and we're just getting started. The industry has noticed:
  
  

* Inc. 5000 — Fastest Growing Private Companies in America
* MSP 501 — ranked among the top managed service providers worldwide
* Inc. Regionals Award — Pacific Northwest
* CRN MSP 500 — Pioneer 250 list

But the awards aren't why people stay. They stay for the culture: team luncheons and employee events that actually feel like events, leadership that knows your name, and a company that shows up for the community — sponsoring and participating in local causes that matter to our team members. We work hard, we win together, and we make sure the wins are felt.
  
  
We're also serious about staying ahead of the curve. We're investing heavily in
**AI modernization**
— putting modern AI-powered tooling in our teams' hands so technicians spend less time on repetitive work and more time solving real problems. When our people say they have the tools to get the job done, we take it seriously: if a tool makes the team faster and the client experience better, we build it, buy it, or adopt it.
  
  
And because we're growing fast, this Director role isn't a ceiling; it's a launch pad. You'll report directly to the COO and help shape how service delivery scales across the company.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and develop the Service Team — direct day-to-day management of the Reactive, Escalated, and Service Coordination teams, including staffing, ticket life-cycle, and workload balancing by role and skill level
* Own escalations end to end — make sure tickets escalate into and within Escalated Service (and to other FusionTek teams) correctly, using our SLA matrix to keep every ticket prioritized right
* Drive the metrics that matter — manage the department to target KPIs for resolution time, CSAT, time spent, and more, and report weekly on service trends and Escalated Service metrics to the CEO
* Keep the on-call rotation healthy — maintain the On-Call Escalated rotation and coordinate with the Service Desk Manager so coverage is always sufficient
* Build and improve the playbook — create, update, and enforce the processes our Service Team runs on, keeping everything documented, audited, and regularly improved
* Drive efficiency and protect margins — keep tickets moving and technicians focused, so time is spent where it creates value: ensuring a minimum of 6.5 billable hours logged per 8-hour shift, catching tickets that quietly over-consume time, and preserving both profitability and the client experience
* Be the connector — partner with projects team, client account management, and sales so the Service Team and the whole company run smoothly and build client relationships that strengthen FusionTek's reputation for technical excellence
* Grow your people — conduct and share Service Team performance reviews through Weekly L10s, Quarterly Conversations, and annual reviews using our defined processes. Our goal: voluntary turnover under 5% annually

**Requirements**
**Technical Skills & Qualifications**

* A solid technical foundation in a stack like ours — Microsoft 365, Azure/Entra ID, Windows Server, networking fundamentals, and Datto BCDR. Direct experience with these exact technologies isn't required, but comparable hands-on knowledge is: you can hold your own in a technical conversation, understand root causes well enough to challenge a resolution plan, and know when an escalation is heading the wrong direction
* Exceptional written and verbal communication — you can talk to technicians, clients, and the CEO with equal clarity
* A calm head under pressure: you manage multiple priorities, resolve conflict fairly, and solve problems before they become fires
* A team-first mindset — you give and accept feedback sincerely and put the team's success above your own
* Self-motivated and curious; you enjoy learning new things
* A valid driver's license and reliable, insured vehicle
* Industry certifications strongly preferred (e.g., Microsoft, CompTIA, or similar); additional certification requirements to be agreed upon during the hiring process
* High school diploma required; bachelor's degree in a related field preferred

**Benefits**
At
**FusionTek**
, we truly believe our people are our most valuable asset. That's why we're proud to offer:
  
  

* 💰 Competitive salary: $120k - $150k/year
* 🎯 Bonus structure tied to personal and departmental KPIs — up to 4% per quarter plus an additional 5% annually
* 🌎 Must reside in Tampa area
* 🏥 Comprehensive coverage: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
* 📈 401(k) plan with 4% company matching and immediate vesting
* 🌴 Time Off That Actually Lets You Recharge: Generous PTO, Paid company holidays, Dedicated Birthday PTO and 2 additional floating holidays for extra flexibility

Title: Manager Data Center Operations
Description:
**Manager Data Center Operations**

**Your role**

The Manager Data Center Operationsis responsible for overseeing the execution of local data center operations at one or more data center properties. Data center operations include, but are not limited to:

* Engineering operations and core infrastructure maintenance
* Data center construction management, commissioning and start-up
* Delivery of data center services including colocation, connectivity, raised floor services and deployment
* Installation and management of all cable and network infrastructure supporting facility and customer connectivity
* Technical event management including post-event root cause analysis and infrastructure repair

**What you’ll do**

* Execute all aspects of data center operations including the operation, maintenance and repair of all mission critical equipment and systems supporting a 24x7 data center operation to achieve 100% uptime and 100% compliance with all customer SLAs.
* Supervises all construction activity and installations, in coordination with internal and external construction resources, to ensure system design, installation and testing adhere to operational standards.
* Witness testing of all equipment during commissioning and validate sequence of operations and receipt of all operational documentation.
* Manages provisioning of data center services including colocation, connectivity, raised floor services, deployment and any additional services to be delivered to data center customers.
* Manages all local customer installations, in coordination with Sales Engineering, Design & Construction and Colocation Operations to coordinate customer move-ins and turn-ups, including deployments, power circuit installations and connectivity requirements.
* Oversees local installation, maintenance and repair of all network infrastructure supporting all Digital Realty and customer connectivity in coordination with internal IT and network personnel.
* Supervise local engineering team to ensure adherence to standard operating procedures, sequence of operations and maintenance standards to guarantee execution of Digital Realty’s periodic maintenance program and maintenance calendar.
* Develop, implement and audit local standard operating procedures, sequence of operations and maintenance standards to be in compliance with Digital Realty’s standards and industry best practices.
* Supervise local change management processes including the review and approval of all Method of Procedures (MOPs) for maintenance and one-time/emergency repair events in coordination with onsite personnel, contractors and customers.
* Manage all maintenance and repair contracts to ensure compliance with maintenance standards and operational requirements. Confirm all vendors are qualified and adhere to Digital Realty’s performance standards and scopes of work.
* Responsible for timely execution of data center services such as remote hands, customer installations and service requests.
* Supervise security personnel and manage security systems including the adherence to security policies and compliance programs (as required by the Property Manager)
* Act as primary technical and operational contact for data center customers – both as the technical lead and local point of escalation during emergency events and day to day operations. Develop knowledge of customer’s core business and the business function of the customer’s local datacenter operation.
* Manage technical and operational incidents at the property, including the implementation of emergency response procedures, resource coordination, customer communication, root-cause analysis and post event remediation.
* Identify trends and analyze risks to articulate implications and impact to data center operations. Track operational metrics and other data to provide Senior Management oversight and control for both snapshot data and long-term trend analysis.
* Identify process based improvements that generate operational and financial efficiencies including the development and presentation of the business case.
* Support Property Manager with the management of expenses and assist all budgeting, forecasting and reporting requirements by providing capital and expense requirements and justifications.
* Support pre-sales process, including, but not limited to, conducting sales tours and reviewing lease proposals and lease agreements to confirm compliance with Digital Realty standards and local requirements.
* Support various accreditation initiatives, including, but not limited to, SSAE16, SOC2, ISO 27001, etc. as may be required by Digital Realty.
* Maintain compliance with local health & safety (i.e. OSHA) standards and national electrical and building codes.

**What you’ll need**

* 10 years related facility management experience in data center operations (or related electrical or mechanical engineering field) with minimum of 5 years’ experience managing or leading data center operations teams in a large scale mission critical environment. Bachelor’s degree in electrical or mechanical engineering preferred.
* Solid and proven experience in the construction, commissioning, acceptance and operation of mission critical systems, including state-of-the-art electrical distribution systems, static and rotary UPS, emergency standby generation, fire alarm/suppression and monitoring systems
* Extensive knowledge of structured cabling systems, networking and connectivity standards, and hardware installation requirements.
* Proficient experience in colocation operations, including the installation and deployment of cage, rack and cable infrastructure, as well as, power circuit installation and power monitoring.
* Experience working with and deploying telecom and network providers, specifically in Meet Me Room and POP room environments
* Experience managing a change control environment
* Strong quantitative and qualitative reasoning skills, with demonstrated ability to determine event root causes, performance shortfalls and required corrective actions.
* Knowledge of industry data center standards, policies & methodologies
* Knowledge of performance management & critical awareness methods and implementation standards
* Strong interpersonal, presentation and communication skills
* Strong organizational skills and detail oriented
* Experience managing own budget and analyzing expenses
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook and familiarity with Microsoft Project, Visio or AutoCad
* Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM), and power metering system

**A bit about us**

Title: Network Operations Manager

We are looking for an experienced Network Operations Manager to lead a high-performing network engineering team while remaining actively involved in complex technical challenges and enterprise network architecture. You will serve as the senior technical escalation point, guiding critical incident resolution and driving proactive improvements across multiple client networks. Working closely with engineers, service delivery teams, and customers, you will identify operational risks, optimize performance, and deliver cost-effective technology solutions. You will also develop engineering talent, establish technical standards, and ensure consistent service quality across a dynamic managed IT services environment. This is an opportunity to combine advanced networking expertise, strategic decision-making, and people leadership while directly influencing customer satisfaction and operational excellence.
  
  
Accountabilities
  
  

* Network Engineering and Technical Leadership: Serve as the senior technical authority and final escalation point for complex routing, switching, network security, and network diagnostics.
* Design, review, and approve advanced network architectures and configurations, considering infrastructure requirements, hardware and software technologies, business continuity, disaster recovery, and system integration.
* Personally investigate and resolve critical network incidents, lead major incident response, and conduct root-cause analysis to prevent recurring issues.
* Oversee the architecture, standards, and lifecycle management of data center network infrastructure, including Cisco Nexus, Firepower, and SD-WAN environments such as Meraki and Cisco Viptela.
* Establish and maintain engineering standards, configuration baselines, technical documentation, and quality assurance processes.
* Evaluate technical feasibility, deployment strategies, resource requirements, and cost estimates for network projects.
* Proactive Network and Client Improvement: Lead regular assessments of customer network environments to identify security vulnerabilities, reliability risks, capacity constraints, and performance issues before they cause service disruptions.
* Use monitoring platforms, ticket trends, and assessment data to identify recurring problems and implement permanent solutions rather than relying on reactive support.
* Forecast network capacity requirements and align infrastructure planning with evolving business needs.
* Collaborate with Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, and Enterprise Solutions Architects to translate technical findings into clear, practical, and cost-effective recommendations.
* Monitor hardware and firmware lifecycles, security vulnerabilities, and configuration changes across managed environments, coordinating timely remediation.
* Ensure that network recommendations prioritize customer needs, business outcomes, service reliability, and long-term value.
* Team Management and Development: Recruit, onboard, coach, and develop Network Engineers and Senior Network Engineers through technical mentoring, performance management, and certification planning.
* Establish clear team expectations, conduct regular one-to-one meetings and performance reviews, and promote accountability through structured management practices.
* Manage team workloads, project priorities, resource allocation, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Oversee network change management, reviewing and approving proposed changes, maintenance windows, and rollback procedures.
* Coordinate the team's 24/7 on-call rotation and escalation procedures, ensuring appropriate coverage for major incidents and after-hours support.
* Communicate operational status, technical risks, and project outcomes effectively to senior leadership, internal teams, and customers.
* Operations, Compliance, and Vendor Management: Define, monitor, and report on network operations KPIs and service performance indicators.
* Manage relationships with network vendors and telecommunications carriers, including technical escalations, procurement, and licensing decisions.
* Ensure compliance with applicable security, regulatory, and contractual requirements, including HIPAA, PCI, and NIST standards.
* Maintain the confidentiality and security of sensitive company and customer information while ensuring adherence to internal policies and professional standards.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* At least 10 years of professional experience in networking or telecommunications within a service provider, managed service provider (MSP), or enterprise environment.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Senior Network Engineer or in an equivalent position, acting as the primary escalation and network architecture resource for complex environments.
* At least 2 years of experience leading engineering teams as a manager, team lead, or technical lead, with direct responsibility for work allocation, mentoring, and performance.
* Previous experience in an MSP or multi-client service environment is strongly preferred.
* Expert knowledge of enterprise networking fundamentals, including complex routing and switching, high-availability architecture, advanced network security, internet services, protocols, and network diagnostics.
* Advanced proficiency in at least three of the following areas: core routing, core switching, network security, network diagnostics, and application load balancing.
* Strong network architecture, troubleshooting, and analytical capabilities, including the ability to assess technical problems, evaluate alternative solutions, understand business impact, and implement cost-effective improvements.
* Demonstrated experience proactively identifying and resolving network performance, security, and reliability issues.
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, motivate, and hold engineering teams accountable while maintaining hands-on technical involvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders and senior executives.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, incidents, and team responsibilities simultaneously.
* Familiarity with current networking technologies, infrastructure tools, applications, and vendor ecosystems.
* Preferred Certifications: CCNP Enterprise or Security certification, with CCIE considered a significant advantage. Fortinet NSE, Meraki CMNA/ECMS, or equivalent vendor certifications are also valued. ITIL Foundation or a similar IT service management qualification is preferred.
* Technical Platforms and Tools: Experience with Cisco ISR/ASR routers, Catalyst and Nexus switches, Firepower and ASA firewalls, Cisco Viptela and Meraki SD-WAN, Meraki networking and wireless solutions, Fortinet, FortiCloud, FortiClient, Sophos, SonicWall, and Ubiquiti UniFi devices.

* Knowledge of Windows Server environments and services, including Active Directory, DNS, and DHCP.
* Experience with network monitoring and service management tools such as Auvik, Autotask PSA, and IT Glue, or comparable platforms.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Visio, and standard collaboration tools.
* Ability and willingness to learn and support additional networking platforms as required.

Title: Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM), 5G/6G Wireless
Location: San Diego, CA, USA | Santa Rosa, CA, USA
Description:
**Overview**
Keysight is a mission-critical design enablement partner for organizations solving the world’s most complex engineering challenges. With deep engineering expertise and leading design, emulation, and test solutions, our ~16,800 employees help customers in over 100 countries accelerate innovation across communications, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace and defense, semiconductor, and artificial intelligence markets. Learn more about what we do.
  
  
At Keysight, people come together to explore new ideas, challenge what's possible, and advance the technologies defining the future. Here, you'll find opportunities to do your best work, take your career further, and thrive in an award-winning culture. Learn more about our benefits.
  
  
Run the program execution of Keysight's 6G collaborations with the leading wireless chipset and device makers, so that every commitment Keysight makes to these customers lands on the date the customer's engineers need it. The role exists so that Keysight's on-site engineers spend their time in the customer's lab.
  
  
The portfolio covers 6G research testbeds, pre-standard 6G test systems, protocol and physical-layer enablement, and demonstrations tied to the customer's development milestones, and it grows as the 6G programs ramp. The role is part of Keysight's customer-facing technical team for these accounts, within the Wireless organization. The engineering owners in R&D, firmware, planning, services, and support own the work; the program manager owns the plan, record, meetings, follow through, and the written recovery plan when a date does not hold. This is a role for someone who is relentless about documentation and tracking, who runs on data (every status is a number or a date with a source), and who sees around corners: anticipates what could go wrong and flags it early to the right leads.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* WHAT YOU WILL OWN

+ The program record for every engagement, kept current daily: status, named owner, next customer milestone, and date, with a plain reason and a recovery plan on every item that is not on track.
+ The plan of record for each engagement, managed to the customer's ready-to-use date, with Keysight's internal dates for shipment, installation, configuration, acceptance, and first measurements beneath it
+ The program meetings, internal and customer-facing: the agenda, each action assigned to a person with a due date, and the follow-up to closure between meetings
+ Commitments and risks across R&D, firmware, planning, services, and support: anticipated before they surface, tracked to their dates, renegotiated in writing before a date passes, and escalated to Wireless leadership the same day a commitment is known to be at risk
+ Readiness sign-off: no date or readiness claim reaches the customer until the program manager has reviewed the evidence behind it

**What You Will Deliver**

* A program plan per engagement, agreed with the customer's program counterparts and Keysight's R&D and planning owners within 90 days of start, refreshed at every milestone
* Meeting notes within one business day: decisions, owners, and dates
* A weekly written status: the situation, the implication, and the ask
* A monthly program readout: schedule performance against the plan of record, critical path, risks with owners, and a recommended course of action wherever the program is off plan
* A monthly quality report per customer: open issues by priority and age, turnaround against commitments, the trend, and the actions behind any line moving the wrong way
* A root cause and recovery plan on every missed customer milestone, written for an engineering executive audience

**What Success Looks Like**

* Customer milestones are met on the customer's dates
* Risks and slips are raised by the program manager, in writing, with the ask, before the customer or Keysight leadership raises them
* Every open engagement carries a current status, a named owner, a next milestone, and a date, at any point in time
* Plans, notes, status, and readouts are accepted by Wireless leadership at first review

On-site engineers' time is customer and lab time; the program meetings and records run without them in the room
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 8 or more years of technical, customer, or engineering program management in wireless, semiconductor, or test and measurement
* A record of delivering complex, cross-functional programs to completion through teams outside the program manager's own line, in a customer-facing environment
* Working knowledge of cellular systems: 4G and 5G today, the standards path to 6G, the modem and device development cycle, and how test equipment is deployed, accepted, and used in a customer's lab
* Fluency in program mechanics: plans of record, critical path, schedule trend against baseline, risk registers, recovery actions, and executive status reporting
* Relentless follow-through: asks the same owner for the same date until it is written down, and is comfortable being the person in the room who asks
* Rigor about evidence: checks what sits behind a date, a readiness claim, or a dependency rather than accepting it as reported
* Sees around corners: anticipates what could go wrong on a program before it does, and flags it to the right leads while there is still time to act
* Writing that stands on its own: notes, status, and readouts a senior engineering leader can act on at first reading
* Experience working directly with Director-level and above stakeholders, and the discretion to operate inside highly confidential development programs
* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Ability to travel to customer sites as the programs require

**What You Get To Do In This Role**
We are seeking a Manager, Network Reliability and Resiliency to lead a team responsible for the reliability and day-to-day operation of production network services supporting ServiceNow's cloud platform. This is a technical people-manager role. You will develop engineers and manage team priorities while staying actively engaged in complex troubleshooting, high-severity incidents, customer escalations, operational readiness, and reliability improvement.
  
  
You will apply SRE principles to network operations by using service indicators and objectives, error-budget thinking, observability, post-incident learning, and automation to improve availability, reduce operational toil, and make execution safer and more consistent. While this is not an individual contributor role, you must have the technical depth and judgment to guide investigations, challenge assumptions, make risk-based decisions, and help the team reach durable solutions.
  
  
**Lead and develop the team**

* Manage, coach, and develop network reliability engineers through clear goals, regular feedback, performance reviews, and career development.
* Set priorities and ownership for operational work, reliability initiatives, technical debt, and project commitments.
* Build sustainable on-call and escalation practices and promote calm, accountable execution during high-pressure events.
* Hire and onboard new team members and ensure they gain the technical context, operating practices, and support needed to succeed.

**Provide technical and incident leadership**

* Actively engage in complex production troubleshooting and customer-impacting escalations by reviewing evidence, guiding technical hypotheses, identifying risk, and coordinating the right subject-matter experts.
* Lead or support major incident response, including mitigation decisions, stakeholder communication, escalation management, and restoration of service.
* Ensure post-incident reviews identify contributing factors and result in clear, prioritized, and completed preventive actions.
* Review high-risk changes and operational plans for technical soundness, rollback readiness, monitoring coverage, and customer impact.

* Partner with engineering and service owners to define and use meaningful SLIs and SLOs for network services.
* Use error budgets, incident trends, capacity signals, and operational data to balance service reliability, delivery pace, and risk.
* Improve observability, alert quality, dashboards, runbooks, and operational readiness so the team can detect and resolve issues efficiently.
* Track practical reliability outcomes such as availability, recurring incidents, change success, alert effectiveness, and time to detect and recover.

**Embed automation in daily operations**

* Create a strong automation mindset across the team and identify repetitive, error-prone, or slow operational activities that should be eliminated or automated.
* Prioritize automation that improves change safety, validation, triage, remediation, reporting, and operational consistency.
* Work with engineering and automation partners to move useful tools and workflows into production with clear ownership, documentation, monitoring, and support models.
* Measure whether automation reduces toil and operational risk rather than treating automation delivery alone as the outcome.

**Partner across the organization**

* Collaborate with network engineering, SRE, security, platform, data center, customer support, and other partner teams to resolve issues and improve service reliability.
* Represent the team's technical assessment, customer impact, risks, dependencies, and recovery plan clearly to technical and business stakeholders.
* Ensure new technologies, services, and automations meet operational acceptance criteria before the team assumes production ownership.
* Improve incident, change, problem-management, and escalation processes based on operational evidence and team feedback.

* Five or more years of relevant experience in network engineering, network reliability, cloud infrastructure, SRE, or large-scale production operations.
* Experience managing or formally leading engineers, including prioritization, coaching, performance feedback, and delivery accountability.
* Sufficient hands-on technical background to guide production troubleshooting across Linux-based systems and network services. You can interpret logs, metrics, alerts, and packet-level evidence and make sound operational decisions.

* Working knowledge of SRE practices, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, monitoring and alerting, incident management, and post-incident improvement.
* An automation mindset and experience using scripting, workflow automation, or engineering partnerships to reduce manual operational work and improve consistency.
* Experience working with geographically distributed teams and cross-functional partners in software, platform, infrastructure, or cloud services.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment under pressure, and consistent attention to detail.
* Experience using or evaluating AI-assisted tools to improve analysis, decision-making, automation, or team workflows, with appropriate attention to accuracy, security, and operational risk.

Title: Director of IT Service Management
Description:
LightEdge Solutions is developing the IT solutions that will propel businesses forward over the next 10 years. Using a combination of shared and private/dedicated platforms, LightEdge has been successful in offering businesses alternatives that streamline operations, improve reliability and reduce costs.
  
  
If you are passionate about creating real solutions that help businesses with cutting-edge technology, want to be challenged to think out of the box and be in a position where you can impact change on a daily basis, then LightEdge can offer you a dynamic corporate environment built on teamwork and personal responsibility.
  
  
The Director of IT Service Management reports to the Chief Operating Officer and leads Lightedge’s ITSM governance and improvement. The Director directly leads the Change Management function; oversees the CMDB project through completion and transition to operational ownership; sponsors Problem Management by setting best practices, sharing themes and hotspots, and driving action items to closure; and ensures Incident Management processes and tooling are optimized for effective response, communication, and operational visibility. The role sets priorities, aligns cross-functional stakeholders, and measures outcomes across these areas.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Change Management leadership**

* Lead the Change Management function across participating Lightedge teams and own its process, standards, governance, decision rights, and improvement roadmap.
* Set expectations for change types, risk and impact assessment, approvals, scheduling, conflict management, emergency changes, and post-implementation reviews.
* Lead Change Advisory Board (CAB) governance; ensure decisions, risks, conflicts, and follow-up actions have clear owners and are recorded.
* Ensure change records capture implementation, validation, backout, communication, ownership, and relevant links to services, configuration items, incidents, and problems.
* Review change outcomes and trends, including successful, failed, backed-out, emergency, and unauthorized changes; coordinate corrective improvements with responsible teams.
* Partner with ServiceNow administration and development teams to prioritize enhancements that strengthen change controls and make the process easier to use.

**CMDB project oversight**

* Oversee the CMDB project through agreed completion criteria and transition to ongoing operational ownership.
* Monitor project scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, resource needs, vendor deliverables, and acceptance criteria; raise material issues for timely resolution.
* Ensure the project establishes clear configuration item (CI) standards, data ownership, relationships, lifecycle states, quality expectations, and reconciliation practices.
* Coordinate with service, platform, product, licensing, procurement, architecture, and IT teams to improve the accuracy and usefulness of configuration records.
* Confirm discovery, automation, service mapping, and integrations are addressed where they support the approved project outcomes.
* Plan knowledge transfer, documentation, support ownership, and ongoing governance so teams can sustain the project results after completion.

**Problem Management sponsorship**

* Sponsor the Problem Management function and establish practical governance, roles, review cadence, and root-cause and corrective-action practices.
* Review recurring and high-impact issues, incident and problem themes, operational hotspots, risks, and overdue actions with accountable service and technical owners.
* Ensure problem records document known errors, workarounds, contributing factors, root-cause findings, and corrective or preventive actions.
* Track identified actions to completion, verify whether actions reduced recurrence or customer impact, and escalate unresolved risks or ownership gaps.
* Share relevant themes, hotspots, progress, and systemic improvement needs with operational leaders and stakeholders.

**Incident Management process and tooling optimization**

* Ensure Incident and Major Incident processes and ServiceNow tooling support timely restoration, clear ownership, appropriate escalation, and reliable stakeholder communications.
* Review and optimize severity criteria, workflows, response roles, major incident declaration and closure, record quality, and post-incident review practices with incident leaders and operational teams.
* Use incident trends, customer impact, feedback, and process data to identify tooling gaps, recurring friction, and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with ServiceNow administrators, developers, SRE, Support, Monitoring, and service teams to prioritize and implement process, workflow, reporting, and automation improvements.

**ITSM governance, reporting, and continual improvement**

* Set clear ownership, handoffs, escalation paths, minimum records, and controls for the processes within the role’s scope.
* Consult Operations, service owners, technical leaders, Compliance, Product, Architecture, and other affected stakeholders before material process changes.
* Build understanding and adoption through practical communications, training, office hours, accessible documentation, and feedback loops.
* Establish meaningful baselines and measures for change, CMDB project delivery, problem action effectiveness, and incident process and tooling health; report progress and risks to leadership.
* Support audit readiness by maintaining process evidence, control descriptions, records, and training materials, and by coordinating responses to findings.
* Coordinate with owners of related practices such as Knowledge, Service Catalog, Event, Availability, and Service Level Management to maintain appropriate process and tool alignment.

**Guiding Principles**

* Prioritize actions that reduce customer impact, restore service safely, and support clear communications.
* Make process, record, decision, and corrective-action ownership explicit.
* Design processes with the teams that use them and apply controls proportionate to risk and urgency.
* Use trustworthy data and measured outcomes to improve service reliability, adoption, and operational efficiency.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Typically 10+ years of experience in IT Service Management, IT Operations, or a related field, including leadership of cross-functional process improvement.
* Demonstrated experience leading Change Management governance and improving Incident and Problem Management practices.

Description:

We are seeking an IT Manager, Network Operations to lead the team responsible for the reliability, security and growth of our enterprise network. You will manage a team of network engineers, serve as the main escalation point for network reliability, infrastructure expansion and observability, and oversee the structured cabling and site deployment work that supports new and expanding locations. As Saronic scales, you will grow the function into dedicated network operations center (NOC), site deployment and integration teams, and drive our shift toward infrastructure as code and automation.
  
  
You are a hands-on leader who combines technical depth with people management and strategic planning. As Saronic grows, you will build the team, processes and standards that keep our network optimized and secure at scale.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop a team of network engineers ranging from associate to staff level, with full accountability for hiring, development, performance and retention.
* Set goals and expectations, run regular 1:1s and performance reviews, and make compensation and leveling recommendations.
* Build and scale the function into dedicated NOC, site deployment and integration teams, including staffing and coverage models.
* Own operational delivery and KPIs for network operations, including SLAs, uptime, change success rate and project delivery.
* Serve as the main escalation point for network incidents, reliability and infrastructure expansion, and build incident response processes with clear severity tiers, escalation paths, runbooks and post-incident reviews to reduce time to resolution.
* Own the monitoring, alerting and observability strategy, including tooling, tuning and dashboards.

* Experience managing budgets, vendors and procurement.
* Strong project management skills across concurrent, geographically distributed projects.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

**DESCRIPTION**

Join our dynamic team and become a critical technical leader who ensures the heartbeat of our global infrastructure remains strong and resilient. In this pivotal role, you'll be the guardian of our data center operations, driving reliability and performance while optimizing operational efficiency across complex technical environments.
  
  
Data Center Facility Manger role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Title: Network Infrastructure Manager
Description:
**Summary**
The Network Infrastructure Manager leads Great HealthWorks' Network Operations and Telecommunications teams — System Administrators, Systems Engineers, Telecom Administrator, and Telecom Engineer/Architect — and carries direct technical accountability for the network, systems, and telecom environments the team supports. This includes firewalls and routing, server, storage, and virtualization infrastructure, as well as the Company's carrier, voice platform, and contact center stack.
  
  
This is a technical leadership position balanced with operational execution. The Infrastructure Manager serves as the primary owner of day-to-day operations and escalations, the main point of contact for business and IT stakeholders, and the driving force behind resolving complex technical issues. This role directly owns the operational layer while remaining hands-on enough to review designs, troubleshoot escalated issues, and lead through major incidents. Additionally, the role is responsible for instilling operational rigor—ensuring requirements discovery, runbooks, and post-change validation are seamlessly integrated into team workflows.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Technical Leadership & Team Management
  
  

* Directly manage and mentor the Network Operations team (System Administrators, Systems Engineers) and Telecommunications team (Telecom Administrator, Telecom Engineer/Architect); set technical priorities and hold the team to a high bar on quality
* Stay close enough to the environment to review designs and configurations, unblock hard technical problems, and lead the team through major incidents, including voice platform and contact center architecture decisions
* Hire and retain strong technical talent, conduct performance reviews, and manage staffing and on-call coverage for a 24/7 environment

Operational Leadership & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Serve as the primary day-to-day operational and escalation owner for Network Operations and Telecommunications — the first point of accountability when something breaks or a decision is needed
* Own communication with business and IT stakeholders on service health, incidents, and project status, serving as a transparent, trusted advisor to leadership.
* Translate technical issues into business impact, risk, and next steps for non-technical stakeholders and leadership
* Drive issue ownership and follow-through, ensuring every open issue has a clear owner, mitigation plan, and target resolution timeline.
* Coordinate across IT, vendors, and business teams to keep cross-functional work and vendor commitments moving
* Maintain visibility into service health, aging issues, recurring problems, and operational risk, and surface it proactively rather than waiting to be asked
* Define and apply clear criteria for what gets escalated to IT leadership versus what this role is expected to own and resolve independently

Network, Systems & Security Operations
  
  

* Own network security (firewall), routing and switching, EDR, and DNS filtering
* Own enterprise storage (Nimble, QNAP, Quantum), XCP-NG virtualization, Windows and Linux server administration (Linux-heavy), Active Directory, and Okta
* Own Microsoft 365 administration and build out the team's SharePoint administration capability
* Own AWS, Cloudflare, and integration of the broader SaaS footprint, plus server backup and disaster recovery
* Maintain PCI compliance across in-scope systems, ensure SLAs are met, and drive capacity planning and script/automation practices across the team

Telecommunications Operations
  
  

* Own operation of the Company's custom-built phone system, voice and data carrier services, and the contact center platform (e.g., NICE InContact/CXone), including the design and engineering work done by the Telecom Engineer/Architect
* Manage carrier relationships, SLAs, and invoicing; monitor the telecom service ticket queue (InvGate) and drive escalations to resolution
* Ensure telecom integrations (contact center, voice platform, speech IVR, SMS) stay supported and issues are triaged quickly

Planning, Documentation & Vendor Management
  
  

* Scope infrastructure and telecom projects up front — gather real requirements, build workable schedules, and keep initiatives on track
* Require runbooks for recurring operational and change work, and a validation step after major changes, so outcomes are confirmed and documented rather than assumed
* Manage vendor and carrier relationships and contracts, build business cases for technology investments, and own the network/systems/telecom budget

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent hands-on experience
* 5+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in IT infrastructure, network, systems, or telecommunications
* 3+ years leading or mentoring technical staff
* Experience scoping and running technical projects — gathering requirements and managing timelines — without a dedicated PM function
* Experience as the primary operational and escalation owner for a technical team, including regular communication with non-technical business stakeholders
* Strong understanding of ITIL and formal change management

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Deep, current technical knowledge of networking (OSI, TCP/IP, routing/switching), firewalls, and identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta)
* Hands-on experience with Windows and Linux administration, enterprise storage (Nimble/QNAP/Quantum), and virtualization (XCP-NG or equivalent)
* Experience with AWS, Cloudflare, Microsoft 365, and integrating a broad SaaS footprint; SharePoint administration a plus
* Experience with carrier/telecom management, contact center platforms, and PCI compliance
* Scripting and automation fluency (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash, Ansible)
* Able to scope, document, and validate work without losing technical credibility with a highly technical team
* Strong ability to translate technical issues into business impact, risk, and next steps for non-technical audiences and leadership
* Proven stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination skills across IT, vendors, and business teams
* Excellent leadership and communication skills; highly self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable working hands-on when needed

Physical Demands and Work Environment
  
  
While performing duties of job, incumbent is occasionally required to:
  
  

* May include local and out-of-town travel depending on business needs.
* Operate in a professional office environment.
* Constantly use work-related equipment.
* Occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
* Sit for extended periods of time (up to 10 hours per day).
* Lift files, open filing cabinets and bend or stand, as necessary.
* Ability to work regular, full-time schedule, Monday through Friday with the flexibility to work additional hours depending on business demands.

Title: Delivery Manager, CRM & Enterprise Applications
Description:
**WHO WE ARE**

GreenShield is a proudly Canadian, national non-profit health care and insurance organization, driven by our mission of Better Health for All. We believe health care is a right, not a privilege, and we are committed to improving health outcomes, advancing health equity, and building a future where every Canadian can reach their full health and well-being potential.

Through our unique integrated payer-provider ("payvider") model, we offer insurance, administer benefits, and pay claims as a ‘payer’ while offering health care services such as mental health, pharmacy, telemedicine, and chronic disease management as a ‘provider’. As a non-profit social enterprise without shareholders, we reinvest our excess earnings to directly support underserved communities. Through GreenShield Cares, we positively impacted the health and well-being of over one million Canadians between 2020 and 2025. What’s driving us now is the commitment to measurably impact an additional three million Canadians by 2030 – across mental health, essential medicines, and chronic disease management – through scalable initiatives that deliver meaningful change in pursuit of our mission of Better Health for All.

At GreenShield, our culture is where purpose meets passion and performance. Our teams work as one to deliver meaningful, measurable impact for the people and communities we serve.

**THE ROLE IN A NUTSHELL**

**Salary : 72,521.00$-142,069.00$**

We’re looking for a
**Delivery Manager, CRM & Enterprise Applications**
to lead the operational delivery, stabilization, and continuous improvement of critical platforms supporting GreenShield’s contact centre and enterprise operations.

This is not a traditional project management role focused primarily on schedules and status reporting. You will take ownership of delivery across an integrated technology environment that includes Microsoft Dynamics 365, NICE CXone, the Unified Service Layer, and Workday. You will bring together technical teams, vendors, product owners, and business stakeholders to resolve incidents, monitor service performance and costs, prioritize enhancements, and ensure our platforms continue to meet evolving business and customer needs.

You are an adaptable and accountable delivery leader who can bring structure to ambiguity, coordinate teams through complex operational challenges, and communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences. You are comfortable moving between incident management, service performance, vendor discussions, cost analysis, and continuous improvement.

You bring:

* Experience managing vendors, service providers, and cross-functional stakeholder relationships.
* Experience monitoring SaaS licensing, cloud consumption, technology costs, or FinOps reporting.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
* Project management capabilities combined with a broader operational delivery and platform ownership mindset.

**EDUCATION AND PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Business Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Certifications in Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Workday, ITIL, FinOps, or project management are considered assets.
* Experience in group benefits, insurance, healthcare, financial services, or another regulated environment is an asset but not mandatory.

We believe a career should be meaningful. Not just a means to earn a living. Our culture is one where everyone's voice is heard and valued. Because that’s what it takes to create better health for all. We dare to challenge the status quo. And we’re driven by people who have challenged theirs. We believe that your workplace should empower you to be the best version of yourself. That’s why we provide a place where you can be inspired, challenged, and rewarded.

Where your growth means our growth.

Where your voice is heard and valued.

Where your work has purpose. And purpose matters.

We believe our people are critical to our overall success. Inclusivity makes us a stronger, smarter and more informed organization. Being intentionally inclusive of diverse backgrounds, perspectives and experiences will enhance our company culture to positively impact how we support our communities. A career at GreenShield isn’t just about personal achievements, it's about making a difference together.

Here’s to Better Health for All!
