Title: Head of Service Delivery
Description:
We're Scan.com. We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better-value diagnostic imaging. Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.
  
  
We manage the medical imaging pathway end-to-end. Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway. Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.
  
  
We're looking for a
**Head of Service Delivery**
at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year on year.
  
  
Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.
  
  
**What You Might Bring To The Table**
You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth role, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:
  
  

* Direct people-management experience leading managers or team leads, not just individual contributors.
* You are service-obsessed and focused on how we deliver outstanding service to patients, partners, and colleagues alike.
* A track record managing vendors within a healthcare operations role.
* Experience managing third-party vendor relationships, including contract negotiation and SLA governance.
* Experience overseeing Workforce Management (WFM) — forecasting, scheduling, and intraday management.
* Experience building or overseeing Quality Assurance (QA) programs, including audit frameworks and calibration.
* A data-first mindset, comfortable building and reading vendor and team scorecards.
* Comfort operating at high speed without compromising on execution quality.
* Strong communication skills, able to translate complex, cross-functional work for executives and your own team alike.
* Experience redesigning operational workflows around automation or AI, with results you can quantify: handle time, cost per order, headcount avoided.
* Able to build a capacity model that forecasts both human and automated throughput, and shows where the next headcount dollar should go versus the next automation dollar.
* Experience structuring vendor contracts for shifts in workload: volume flexibility, per-outcome pricing, exit terms, and automation clauses.
* Comfortable setting quality standards for automated and agentic systems, and holding Product and Engineering to them.
* A working view on PHI and AI: what data can enter which tools, what a BAA must cover, and how to audit it.
* Able to judge AI vendor claims. You can tell a demo from a deployed result and ask for the evidence.

**What You Will Achieve In This Role**
This role sits within Service Delivery, reporting directly to the SVP of Operations. You'll own two core pillars — Workforce Management (WFM) and Quality Assurance (QA) — plus our vendor partnerships, leading a small team of functional leads (a WFM Lead and a QA Lead) who run the day-to-day.
  
  
**Role**
As a scale-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the types of things you could be getting involved in:
  
  

* Build, lead, and develop a team of functional leads across WFM and QA, growing their capability to run their pillars independently.
* Own the end-to-end vendor lifecycle — sourcing, onboarding, contract structuring, performance management, and offboarding.
* Set the strategy for Quality Assurance (QA) — audit frameworks, calibration, scorecards, and coaching feedback loops. You will also be standing up the infrastructure for product testing on behalf of operational functions.
* Set the strategy for Workforce Management (WFM) — demand forecasting, staffing plans, scheduling, and capacity modeling — across internal and outsourced teams.
* Standardize reporting across QA and WFM, including SLA/KPI dashboards and vendor and team scorecards.
* Partner with the SVP of Operations on Service Delivery strategy, headcount planning, and budget for the function.
* Represent Service Delivery in cross-functional and executive conversations, translating team-level performance into business impact.
* Lead HIPAA compliance and data security oversight across all outsourced operations. - Own the automation roadmap for Service Delivery.
* Set and own a target for cost per order, defect rates, and key cost metrics
* Rebuild WFM to forecast mixed human and automated capacity, so staffing plans and vendor commitments track the real demand curve, in real time.
* Help set the quality framework for agentic workflows: error tolerance, escalation paths, human-in-the-loop points, and audit coverage.
* Act as the operational owner for Product and Engineering on Courier automation. Define what good looks like, test it, and sign off before patient-facing release.
* Make AI-assisted work the default across your team, and measure adoption and output gains at team level.
* Lead HIPAA and data security oversight across outsourced operations and AI tooling, including vendor due diligence and BAAs.

**Ai Requirements**
At Scan.com, AI isn't a side project; it's how we work. We expect everyone to use AI to think faster, remove drudgery, and multiply their output. What we care about is judgment: knowing when AI makes you sharper, when it doesn't, and how to use it responsibly around patient data. You don't need to be an engineer. You need to be someone who reaches for the best tool and gets more done as a result.
  
  
**Tier 1 — AI-Native**
For this role, the expectation is that you are AI-native. You build with AI directly, shipping, automating, or prototyping real work with LLMs and agents, and have clear judgment on where humans must stay in the loop.
  
  

* You build with AI, not just alongside it. You've shipped, automated, or prototyped something real using LLMs, agents, or AI tooling.
* You can explain a workflow you redesigned so a machine does the boring 80%.
* You have a view on where agentic systems help and where a human must stay in the loop, especially in regulated, PHI-adjacent work.

**A VIEW ON OUR CULTURE**
We're building something that matters. Every scan we speed up is a real person waiting on an answer, and that urgency runs through everything we do. We move fast, we own outcomes, and take pride in our output. If you like ambiguity, working with ambitious people, and want your work to visibly move the needle, you'll feel at home here.
  
  
**How We Will Interview You**
We keep our interview process short and sweet. Here are the stages you can expect, but we might switch up the order depending on team availability:
  
  

* 30-minute introductory phone call with our Senior Talent Partner.
* If it feels like there is an initial fit for all, we will invite you to a 45-minute video call with the hiring manager. This is a more structured interview that will deep-dive into the role and technical needs.
* 'Scan Standard' interview, where our panel screens for values alignment and the success factors that matter at Scan.com. You will also be assessed on your AI fluency at the stage and depth relevant to this role (see AI Requirements above).
* Meet the founders and/or other team members. Again, the length varies depending on how many people are involved and whether in person or via video call.
* Offer!

**What We Offer**
We go beyond the basics with our benefits package. We believe great work starts with supporting our people. Here's what you can expect from us:
  
  

* Salary range of $150,000 - $180,000
* Equity package
* Flexible remote or hybrid work options
* Dedicated personal development budget
* Medical, vision, and dental coverage
* 28+ days of paid time off across PTO and wellbeing days, so you can show up at your best
* Paid parental leave
* 401k retirement plan
* All the equipment you need to do your best work
* Inclusive, people-first policies designed by our team, for our team

**DIVERSITY AT**
**SCAN.COM**
Scan.com is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity within our team. We strive to provide equality and fairness for all job applicants and employees and never discriminate on the basis of gender, marital status, age, race, ethnicity, religion, or physical differences.
  
  
We are opposed to all forms of unlawful treatment and discrimination.
  
  
Our ambition is for our team to be representative of society's diversity, and for every employee to feel respected and able to bring their best selves to work.
  
  
If you need an accommodation to apply or interview, contact us at people@scan.com.
  
  
We look forward to receiving your application!

Title: Incident and Problem Manager

Title: Sr Manager, IT Service Delivery
Description:
Anteris® Technologies is a global structural heart company dedicated to revolutionizing cardiac care. With offices in Minneapolis, MN, US; Geneva, Switzerland; and Brisbane and Perth, Australia, we have a growing and inclusive team.
  
  
Our mission is to forge new frontiers in cardiac care by pioneering science-driven and measurable advancements to restore heart valve patients to healthy function. Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR) technologies were originally designed for older, high-risk patients. Today, younger, more active patients need a better solution that will not just open and close but restore healthy heart function. We seek to restore healthy blood flow patterns by creating the world’s first biomimetic TAVR valve, DurAVR® THV. This cutting-edge valve, incorporating our proprietary ADAPT® anti-calcification technology, is designed to mimic the natural function of a healthy heart valve.
  
  
*Build the service model. Lead the team. Shape how our employees experience IT.*
We are a young, growing company, and our IT organization is growing with it. That makes this a build-and-lead role, not a caretaker role. The person who joins us will have the opportunity to define and own how IT service delivery works across the organization: how employees get help, how support is staffed and measured, how issues are escalated, how vendors fit into the model, and what a great technology experience should look like as we scale.
  
  
The audience is broad. You and your team will support field personnel, commercial and sales teams as those capabilities grow, R&D engineers, Quality and regulatory functions, corporate teams, executives, and everyone in between. This role will be one of the most visible faces of IT to our internal customers. How this function performs will shape how the organization experiences and judges IT - good or bad.
  
  
We are looking for a leader who values real IT discipline and great customer experience, in equal measure. Great CX does not mean saying yes to everything. It means being responsive, reliable, consistent, easy to work with, transparent about priorities, and willing to say “no” or “not that way” when a one-off request conflicts with security, standards, scalability, or our shared business goals. It also means representing the internal customer inside IT and holding our own teams and partners accountable when the experience, responsiveness, or quality of service falls short of the standard we are trying to build.
  
  
As Anteris grows, this role will grow with it. The service model, team structure, global coverage, technology estate, and business expectations will all become more complex. For the right leader, that creates meaningful opportunity to expand scope, responsibility, and career progression as the company and IT organization mature.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* Lead and develop our Service Desk, deskside support, and related Service Delivery resources (employees, contractors, and service partners) with clear expectations, coaching, accountability, and career development.
* Define and mature a scalable global IT service-delivery model across support channels, locations, vendors, escalation paths, service levels, and operating hours.
* Own the employee technology experience within Service Delivery and use service data, customer feedback, ticket trends, and direct engagement to identify friction and drive measurable improvement.
* Establish practical ITSM discipline across incident, request, problem, knowledge, change, service catalog, asset, and continual-improvement practices. We want rigor that improves outcomes, not process for process’s sake.
* Lead significant incidents and escalations with calm, clear ownership — coordinating technical teams, vendors, business stakeholders, communications, and follow-through through resolution and post-incident improvement.
* Lead Service Delivery projects and improvement initiatives such as ITSM enhancements, service-model changes, endpoint or technology deployments, office/site support changes, vendor transitions, automation, and self-service improvements.
* Own service-provider performance and ensure MSPs and vendors operate as an extension of our team, with clear accountability for quality, responsiveness, customer experience, and contractual commitments.
* Lead end-user technology fulfillment and lifecycle practices, including onboarding/offboarding, device provisioning, asset control, refresh planning, recovery, and retirement.
* Partner closely with Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Applications, Data, Quality, HR, Facilities, and business leadership so employees experience one IT organization rather than disconnected technical teams.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Employees know where to go for help, receive consistent service, and trust that IT will own issues through resolution.
* The Service Delivery team is well-led, accountable, developing professionally, and increasingly able to solve problems without unnecessary escalation.
* Service levels, backlog, recurring issues, customer experience, vendor performance, and improvement priorities are visible and actively managed, not anecdotally.
* IT becomes more disciplined as we grow: better standardization, better knowledge, more automation, fewer repeat problems, and clearer ownership.
* You are a credible partner to the business: customer-focused and pragmatic, while protecting enterprise standards, security, compliance, scalability, and shared priorities.
* You are a credible leader inside of IT - where we look to you for voice-of-the-customer and help IT deliver IT correctly.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field is preferred. An equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience will also be considered.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in IT service delivery, IT operations, end-user computing, IT service management, or related technology disciplines.
* 5+ years of people-management experience with direct leadership of Service Desk, deskside/end-user support, IT operations, or comparable technology teams.
* Demonstrated ability to coach and develop people, manage performance, create accountability, and build stronger teams, not simply manage a queue.
* Strong, practical ITSM experience and an understanding of ITIL principles, service levels, problem management, knowledge management, change, metrics, and continual improvement.
* Experience leading technology or service-improvement projects from planning through implementation and transition to support; formal project-management certification is useful but not required.
* Experience using service-performance and customer-experience data to make decisions, identify systemic issues, and drive improvement.
* Experience managing MSPs, contractors, vendors, and blended internal/external delivery models with measurable performance expectations.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft-centric workplace technology, including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, SaaS applications, endpoint management, identity/access concepts, and enterprise service-management tools.
* Experience supporting multiple sites or a distributed/global workforce.
* Experience in medical device, life sciences, manufacturing, healthcare, or another regulated environment is strongly preferred.
* A leadership style that combines service orientation, sound judgment, technical credibility, operational discipline, and the confidence to challenge weak assumptions or unsustainable requests.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to make a significant impact on the healthcare industry by advancing groundbreaking therapies.
* Inclusive Team Environment, collaborative and dynamic work environment with a culture of innovation and excellence.
* Competitive compensation package, including salary, performance-based bonuses, and stock options.
* Career development opportunities and a chance to be part of a growing company that values its employees.

**Health and Wellness Offerings**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Plans
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* 401k + Company Match
* Life, AD&D, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
* Bonus Plan Eligibility
* Employee Equity Program
* Paid Holidays & Vacation
* Employee Assistance Program

*This is the national market pay scale.*
Salary Range
  
  
$150,000 - $180,000 USD
  
  
Note: We may require proof of COVID-19 vaccination to comply with health institutions, state, local municipality, and/or travel regulations.
